text:
Here’s a polished version of your review that keeps your strong negative opinion while making it more structured, credible, and impactful:

⸻

★☆☆☆☆ – One of the Most Disappointing Michelin Experiences I’ve Ever Had

I genuinely do not understand how Restaurant Facil holds two Michelin stars. Having dined at many Michelin-starred restaurants, this was easily one of the most underwhelming experiences I’ve had.

The problems started with the service. While one or two servers were genuinely warm and professional, the majority came across as cold, unengaged, and uninterested in communicating. Basic English seemed to be a challenge for several members of the team, making it difficult for them to explain the dishes. At this level, every course should be introduced with confidence and enthusiasm. Instead, it often felt awkward and uninformed.

Even before arriving, there were signs that attention to detail was lacking. On the day of our reservation, Google Maps listed the restaurant as “Temporarily Closed.” For a two-Michelin-star establishment, this is the sort of basic operational detail that should never be overlooked. When I mentioned it to the staff, my feedback was simply brushed aside, reflecting an unfortunate lack of care.

As for the food, it was astonishingly ordinary. There was nothing memorable, innovative, or technically impressive about most of the menu. It felt like standard Western cuisine without any creativity or ambition. Rather than highlighting the quality of the ingredients, many dishes were excessively salty, masking their natural flavours with seasoning. I kept waiting for a course that would justify the restaurant’s reputation, but it never came.

The only exception was the dessert course. Here, the kitchen finally showed some imagination, with creative presentations and a touch of theatricality. Unfortunately, one good dessert course cannot redeem an otherwise forgettable meal.

The dining environment also left much to be desired. The restaurant features a retractable roof, which is undoubtedly beautiful when open. However, it remained closed for most of our nearly three-hour meal, leaving the room feeling stuffy with stagnant air. It was only opened towards the very end, by which point it made little difference to the overall experience.

Ultimately, this meal felt like a complete waste of both time and money. I left wondering not what I had enjoyed, but how this restaurant earned—and continues to hold—two Michelin stars. Aside from the desserts and the potential beauty of the venue when the roof is open, I found very little to recommend.

I’ve had exceptional experiences at Michelin-starred restaurants around the world, so my expectations were high. Restaurant Facil fell dramatically short of them. Unfortunately, this ranks among the worst Michelin dining experiences I’ve had.
ownerResponseText:
Dear Guest,

thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback about your visit to FACIL Restaurant.

We are very sorry to read that your experience fell so far short of your expectations. Your comments regarding the service, the communication in English, the presentation of the dishes, the seasoning and the overall atmosphere are taken very seriously. The standard you describe is not the experience we aim to provide, and we fully understand your disappointment given the expectations associated with a two Michelin star restaurant.

We are, however, pleased that the dessert course and its presentation stood out positively for you. Your feedback regarding the retractable roof and the room climate is equally valuable, as the atmosphere of the restaurant is an important part of the overall experience.

We also sincerely apologize for the incorrect “Temporarily Closed” information shown on Google Maps on the day of your reservation. During our summer closure, this status was generated automatically following a suggestion submitted by a Google user and could only be corrected afterwards through Google’s system, which unfortunately involved a delay. We understand how confusing this must have been and thank you for bringing it to our attention.

As your review raises several points concerning both the service and the menu, we would very much appreciate the opportunity to understand the circumstances of your visit in more detail. If you would be willing to share further information with us, please contact us directly at welcome@facil.de. We would be grateful for the opportunity to look into your experience carefully.

Thank you again for your candid feedback.

Warm regards,
Your FACIL Team

A Michelin Restaurant Visited During a Solo Trip to Berlin

I visited after booking a lunch course that was reasonably priced.

First off, the view from the restaurant was better than any other Michelin restaurant I've ever been to. It felt like entering heaven, which put me in a good mood right from the start.

The food was delicious overall, and I was amazed by the class of Berlin's Michelin scene, being able to enjoy such quality food for under 100 euros. In particular, I felt the quality of the desserts was 3-star level.

If there was one downside, it was that while the meal was fine from the beginning to the middle, as the number of guests increased towards the end, I felt like they were gradually losing interest in me. For instance, while I was waiting outside after paying, no one immediately took my jacket.

However, aside from that, I felt it was a restaurant with no other shortcomings. I would like to visit again with my family for dinner someday.

text:
We had been looking forward to the chic dinner at Facil in Berlin, awarded 2 Michelin stars, for quite some time. Because we do not eat meat, we opted for the vegetarian menu, which is slightly cheaper than the regular menu. We chose the 7-course menu once and the 8-course menu once. The dining room is beautifully situated on an upper floor of the hotel, though there is no view. To create a garden atmosphere, there is a constantly flowing fountain, which causes some noise disturbance. The service at the beginning was very quick and attentive, giving a welcoming feeling. The language at the table occasionally switched between English and German, but that was not a major problem. The wine list is quite extensive, with a focus on German wines. Quite pricey, but that is to be expected with 2 stars. There are, however, a few wines under €100 that are worth trying.

The younger sommelier was a star, very helpful throughout the evening, with fine humor.
Unfortunately, we were not blown away by the vegetarian menu. The presentation was beautiful, but the flavors were sometimes a bit too sour and not surprising enough. It was also noticeable that all amuse-bouches and courses 1 through 5 were cold, while courses 6 and 7 were lukewarm (as intended). At this price level, things can and should be (much) better. Two dishes with peas in one menu is perhaps a bit much, and pea shoots were served on several courses. They are not tasty and serve only as garnish, but that is 'not done' in our eyes.

Our current rating is just barely 1 star, but the price level is equivalent to 2.5 stars.
Fortunately, the staff noticed our slight disappointment and we were compensated in a pleasant manner. Bravo for being open to constructive criticism.
Our advice regarding the vegetarian cuisine and the wine list: ensure innovation and be inspired by what is happening in the world.

text:
I’m a tourist from France, and before coming to New York, I did some research on the places you supposedly “shouldn’t miss.” Joe’s Pizza at 1435 Broadway was one of them.
I had seen information suggesting that pizza slices were around $2. Let me be very clear: that was absolutely not my experience.
As a European and someone familiar with Italian food, I know what a simple cheese pizza is supposed to be: straightforward, good-quality ingredients, proper cheese, and a good crust. What I was served here was honestly disgusting. The cheese was like mush, the quality was extremely disappointing, and it was nothing like the famous New York pizza experience I had been expecting.
What bothered me even more was the feeling that tourists are simply there to be rushed through, served whatever they are given, and charged. I did not feel welcomed or valued as a customer at all. It felt like: pay, eat, and get out.
Maybe Joe’s Pizza earned its reputation many years ago, but I’m writing this review as a tourist visiting New York in 2026, and based on my personal experience, I simply do not understand the hype.
For such a famous name, serving pizza of this quality and treating tourists this way is a real shame.
Very disappointing experience. I cannot recommend this place, and personally, I would avoid it.

text:
We spent the weekend in Berlin, primarily to eat at FACIL. To cut to the chase: the trip would have been worth it even if we'd had to travel to the far side of the moon instead of Berlin.

All joking aside, everything was perfect: The food was absolutely superb. The photo shows our dessert, undoubtedly the highest honor a strawberry can receive. It's true artistry.

The service was excellent, unhurried, relaxed, refreshingly humorous, and refreshingly unpretentious. I can't imagine how it could be improved.

The ambiance: FACIL, as a restaurant within the Mandala hotel, is perfectly situated: an oasis of calm and peace amidst the hustle and bustle of Potsdamer Platz. You sit in a glass pavilion surrounded by a bamboo garden, all on the fifth floor. It's brilliantly constructed. In good weather, the roof and walls open up, immersing you in nature – something almost unimaginable from outside the hotel. After dinner, you can easily return to one of the truly lovely rooms in just a few steps, without having to get in the car or a taxi. Perfect.

I'd like to end with a thought and the solution to a riddle you might not even know yet:

The thought – Even if fine dining is completely foreign to you, and you might have reservations because you "don't like it" or because of the cost, give it a try. Our greatest treasures are the memories we carry in our hearts, and which restaurant visit from ten years ago do you still remember? I alone will never forget that strawberry.

The answer – "Three and a half kilograms!" That's the answer to ONE question you'll ask yourself without a doubt during the evening. What question? You'll have to go there yourself to find out. Hehe.
originalText:
Wir waren über das Wochenende in Berlin mit dem Haupt-Anreisegrund, im FACIL zu essen. Das Ergebnis vorweg: Die Anreise hätte sich sogar gelohnt, wenn wir nicht nach Berlin, sondern auf die Rückseite des Mondes hätten fahren müssen.
Spaß beiseite - es stimmte alles: Das Essen war ganz hervorragend, Das Foto zeigt unser Dessert, zweifelsohne die höchste Ehrung, die einer Erdbeere überhaupt widerfahren kann. Das ist hohe Kunst.
Der Service war exzellent, unaufgeregt, entspannt, hatte erfrischenden Humor und war auf sehr angenehme Weise nicht steif. Mir fehlt die Phantasie, wie man das besser machen möchte.
Das Ambiente: Das FACIL als Restaurant im Mandala ist hier allerbest aufgehoben: eine Oase der Ruhe und des Friedens inmitten des Gewimmels am Potsdamer Platz. Man sitzt in einem gläsernen Pavillon inmitten eines Bambusgartens, das Ganze im fünften Stock. Großartig gebaut. Bei gutem Wetter öffnen sich Dach und Wände und man befindet sich mitten in der Natur, von außerhalb des Hotels kaum vorstellbar. Nach dem Essen findet man mit wenigen Schritten zurück in eines der wirklich sehr schönen Zimmer, ohne dass man noch ins Auto oder Taxi steigen müsste. Perfekt.
Enden möchte ich mit einem Gedanken und der Auflösung eines Rätsels, dass Ihr noch nicht einmal kennt:
Der Gedanke - Auch, wenn Euch wirklich gehobene Gastronomie fremd sein sollte, Ihr möglicherweise Vorbehalte wegen „Mag ich nicht“ oder des Geldes habt, wagt einen Selbstversuch. Unser größter Schatz sind die Erinnerungen, die wir in unserem Herzen tragen, und an welchen Restaurantbesuch von vor zehn Jahren erinnert Ihr Euch noch? Allein die Erdbeere werde ICH nicht vergessen.
Die Auflösung - „Dreieinhalb Kilogramm“! Das ist die Antwort auf EINE Frage, die Ihr Euch während eines Abends völlig ohne jeden Zweifel stellen werdet. Welche Frage? Dafür müsst Ihr schon selbst hinfahren. Höhö.

We are delighted that you were equally impressed by the cuisine, service, and ambiance during your visit to FACIL. Your praise for our team, whom you found to be warm, relaxed, and professional all at once, means a great deal to us.

We are especially grateful for your kind words about our dessert. That you attribute the "highest honor" to the strawberry and describe it as an unforgettable memory is a wonderful tribute to Thomas Yoshida and our entire kitchen team.

We are equally pleased by your description of FACIL as a tranquil oasis overlooking the rooftops of Potsdamer Platz. This is precisely the interplay of nature, architecture, and culinary delights that we strive to offer our guests.

Thank you for sharing your enthusiasm so vividly with other guests. We look forward to welcoming you back to FACIL on your next visit – and perhaps you'll have a new question with an equally surprising answer.

Sincerely, your FACIL Team

We celebrated our wedding anniversary at Pantry on Friedrichstrasse and had a truly wonderful evening.

From the moment we entered the restaurant, we received a very warm welcome and immediately felt at home. The atmosphere is stylish, cozy, and yet special – perfect for a special occasion or a relaxed evening for two.

The menu offers an excellent selection to suit every taste. Whether you prefer meat, fish, or vegetarian dishes, there's something for everyone. The drinks menu is also extensive and leaves nothing to be desired.

The food was outstanding and completely won us over with its quality, taste, and presentation. You can tell that they use high-quality ingredients and pay great attention to detail.

Pantry is certainly on the pricier side, but considering the quality, service, and overall ambiance, it's more than justified. For special occasions or simply a lovely evening, it's definitely worth the investment.

originalText:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Wir waren anlässlich unseres Hochzeitstages im Pantry in der Friedrichstraße und hatten einen rundum gelungenen Abend.

Bereits beim Betreten des Restaurants wurden wir sehr herzlich empfangen und haben uns sofort willkommen gefühlt. Die Atmosphäre ist stilvoll, gemütlich und gleichzeitig besonders – perfekt für einen schönen Anlass oder einen entspannten Abend zu zweit.

Die Speisekarte bietet eine hervorragende Auswahl für jeden Geschmack. Ob Fleisch, Fisch oder vegetarische Gerichte – hier findet jeder etwas Passendes. Auch die Getränkekarte ist vielfältig und lässt keine Wünsche offen.

Das Essen war ausgezeichnet und hat uns in Qualität, Geschmack und Präsentation absolut überzeugt. Man merkt, dass hier mit hochwertigen Zutaten gearbeitet wird und viel Wert auf Details gelegt wird.

Preislich liegt das Pantry sicherlich etwas im gehobenen Bereich, allerdings ist das angesichts der Qualität, des Services und des gesamten Ambientes mehr als gerechtfertigt. Für besondere Anlässe oder einfach einen schönen Abend ist es die Investition definitiv wert.

Wir haben unseren Hochzeitstag dort sehr genossen und kommen gerne wieder. Klare Empfehlung für alle, die gutes Essen, eine tolle Atmosphäre und herzlichen Service schätzen.

Two of us, both women, went to this restaurant and were stopped and verbally harassed outside by a drunk customer. A member of staff walked past and saw what was happening but showed no concern at all.
After we entered, we were still largely ignored. We were standing in the middle of the restaurant waiting for assistance, only to be told by a staff member not to block the way. After ordering, we then had to wait a very long time for our food despite being hungry.
When we finished eating and wanted to pay, we spoke to a member of staff, who told us that we had to finish our alcoholic drinks first. When we asked again to pay, he finally came over and cleared our plates. Perhaps he intended this as a joke, but as two women dealing with a stranger, we did not find being told that we had to finish our alcohol before we could leave particularly funny or appropriate.
When it came time to pay, we asked for the tip/service charge to be removed. The staff member immediately called us “rude” and, in a very unpleasant manner, told us there was no option to remove the service charge. Only after we insisted again did he press the option on the card machine to remove it.
We have eaten at restaurants in many cities and countries across Europe, but this is the first time I have ever felt compelled to leave a Google review. Unfortunately, this was also the worst overall dining experience we have had.

The place is quite busy, so reservations are definitely a must!

As a first-timer, I loved the experience. However, the friends I was with had done the “Dinner with Friends” a few times before, and they mentioned that some dishes tend to repeat quite often. They were a bit disappointed coming back a few months later and getting almost the same menu.

I was also the only one at the table who did not get the Dinner with Friends option with unlimited drinks. I was still charged separately for sparkling water that I didn’t even touch, which was disappointing.

Overall, a great experience and definitely something I would recommend trying once!

text:
There were two of us. The ambiance was exactly to my taste: dark, understated tones and colors.

Both menus were very interesting; we opted for the non-vegetarian menu and the wine pairing.

What can I say? The individual courses arrived at thoughtful intervals, and each course was accompanied by a perfectly balanced and tasteful wine.

The young waiter was incredibly attentive and friendly. We chatted with him about practically everything under the sun. It was definitely not a pretentious restaurant where you have to watch your every move. Every request was catered to, and each course was explained in detail.

All in all, we spent a good two to three hours there in a very calm and relaxed atmosphere.

If you're looking for something interesting and, above all, extraordinary, Dae Mon is highly recommended. We'll definitely be back when we're in Berlin.
originalText:
Wir waren zu zweit dort. Das Ambiente traf genau meinen Geschmack: Dunkle, dezente Töne und Farben.
Die beiden Menüs waren sehr interessant, wir haben uns für das nicht-vegetarische Menü entschieden und für die Weinbegleitung.
Was soll ich sagen? Die einzelnen Gänge kamen in aufmerksamen Abständen und zu jedem Gang gab es einen wirklich fein abgeschmeckten und passenden Wein.
Der junge Kellner war unglaublich aufmerksam und freundlich. Wir haben mit ihm gefühlt über Gott und die Welt geredet. Also absolut kein "hochgestochenes" Restaurant, in dem man auf jede Bewegung achten muss. Auch wurde auf jeden Wunsch eingegangen und es gab zu jedem Gang eine präzise Erklärung.
Insgesamt waren wir sicherlich 2-3 Stunden dort in einer sehr ruhigen und entspannten Atmosphäre.
Wenn man sich mal was interessantes und v.a. außergewöhnliches gönnen möchte, ist das Dae Mon eine Empfehlung wert. Wir kommen sicher nochmal wieder, wenn wir in Berlin sind.

text:
An evening we won't soon forget! We were at Sky Kitchen two weeks ago and will definitely be back.

In short: the food, service, and atmosphere were all just right. Highly recommended! I'll be back.
originalText:
Ein Abend, den wir so schnell nicht vergessen werden! Wir waren vor zwei Wochen in der Sky Kitchen und kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.

Der Service war wirklich klasse: aufmerksam, freundlich und man hat gemerkt, dass die auf einen eingehen und nicht nur die Bestellungen abarbeiten.

Besonders schön fanden wir, dass der Küchenchef persönlich rauskommt, die Gerichte serviert und erklärt. Das macht das Ganze besonders und man spürt, mit wie viel Herzblut hier gekocht wird.

Auf dem Teller haben uns vor allem der Spargel und die Karotte begeistert. Beide top zubereitet und wirklich ein Genuss. Auch das Brot war richtig gut. Dazu kam eine Weinbegleitung, die wunderbar gepasst hat und die Gänge schön abgerundet hat.

text:
Among German restaurants, the best place for Schweinshaxen is Restauration 1840.

It is the epitome of the classic Schweinshaxen.

It is not salty, yet tender and crispy; pairing it with beer makes all your fatigue melt away.

I had tried German restaurants a few times before, but I hesitated because they were too salty and tough for me.

Based on a good memory, I visited a restaurant in Frankfurt recommended by someone, but it didn't suit my taste.

The portions are large, so you need to be careful with your order.

Located beneath the train station, the acoustics were great when trains passed by, and the interior atmosphere also contributes to the dining experience.

독일 음식점 중 최고의 슈바인학센  맛집은 Restauration 1840.

슈바인학센의 정석과도 같은 곳.
짜지않고 부드러우면서도 바삭 바삭하면서 맥주와 곁들이면 피로가 싹 가신다.

예전부터 독일음식점은 몇번 시도했지만 내가 먹기엔 짜고 너무 딱딱해서 주저했다.
좋은 기억으로 프랑크푸르트에서 소개로 맛집을 방문했으나 나와는 맞지 않았다.

양이 많으니 주문시 양조절을 잘 해야한다.
기차역 아래에 있어 기차가 지나갈 때 울림도 좋았고 내부 분위기도 맛을 돈우는데 한 몫한다.

Had read that the restaurant would have good schnitzel and therefore decided to go there. The prices did not match what was on their website. There was no menu to look at but the staff told us about the different dishes (without stating the price). Since we heard about their schnitzel, the whole group ordered this. Unfortunately, it was not possible to get sauce for your schnitzel, only ketchup and mayonnaise. The food was nothing special, but ok.
Before we ordered food, we asked if it was possible to pay by card and this would not be a problem. When we were going to pay, we found out that it cost €3 extra. Schnitzel cost almost €30/piece.

Then we thought it was a bit strange when the staff themselves drank beer and wine while they were serving guests.

Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else and you will definitely get better schnitzel at a better price, served by sober people.
originalText:
Hade läst att restaurangen skulle ha bra schnitzel och beslutade därför att ta oss dit. Priserna stämde inte med vad som stod på deras hemsida. Det fanns ingen meny att titta i utan personal berättade om de olika rätterna (utan att uppge pris). Eftersom att vi hört om deras schnitzel beställde hela sällskapet detta. Tyvärr gick det inte att få sås till sin schnitzel, endast ketchup och majonnäs. Maten var inget speciellt, men ok.
Innan vi beställde mat frågade vi om det gick att betala med kort och detta skulle inte vara några problem. När vi skulle betala fick vi reda på att det kostade 3€ extra. Schnitzel kostade nästan 30€/styck.

Sen tyckte vi att det var lite märkligt när peraonalen själva drack öl och vin under tiden de serverade gäster.

Gör er själva en tjänst och väl något annat ställe så kommer ni garanterat få godare schnitzel till ett bättre pris, serverat av nyktra människor.

text: First night in Berlin and wanted to visit for the authentic German pub and food reviews posted.  Was easy to find and we were early in the evening and got a table without any issues.  Our waitress was kind enough to translate the German menu into English for us and we went with the veal and venison.  Both beer and wine were good and we went with the recommendations made by our waitress.  Food portions are large, but we both felt that both dishes were very salty by the end of the meal.  Opted for the Apple strudel for dessert, which we shared and was lovely.  Pub itself is a tapestry of old signs which were great to look and the staff were attentive without being obtrusive. text:
I'm a bit perplexed at one of the recent reviews which said meals are 28 euros each but has a photo of the currywurst which, when we were there a few weeks before, was 18.90. We were there early June and the bill was 73 Euros. I had the asparagus and schnitzel at about 28 (this was the most expensive option for this dish - salmon or vegetables in place of schnitzel were less) but the pork knuckle was 22 or 23, plus two large glasses of the house lager each and a pudding.  All were delicious and the guys who run the place were cheerful, friendly and attentive. The house dark lager in particular deserves special mention. The menu isn't online because it depends on the freshness and quality of available ingredients on the day and this is a father and son operation so criticisms of the website are unfair.
This is a family run restaurant knocking out good quality fresh traditional German food and deserves a visit. We'll be back.

AMRIT - Indisches Restaurant Berlin Mitte, Oranienburger Str. 45, 10117 Berlin, Germany
text:
The food was very good and the prices were normal for a restaurant. The staff were very friendly and happy to answer questions, but they seemed a bit rushed when there were a lot of guests.

The surface of the wooden table was slightly sticky and could use some refinishing. Due to the weather, there were a lot of wasps around, which almost led to an accident when one crawled unnoticed into a straw. All in all, though, it was a positive experience, and I'll go again if I'm ever in the area.
originalText:
Das Essen war sehr gut und die Preise normal für ein Restaurant. Die Bedienungen sind sehr freundlich und beantworten Fragen gerne, wirken bei großer Gästeanzahl aber schnell hektisch.
Die Oberfläche des Holztisches war leicht klebrig und müsste Mal überarbeitet werden. Wetterbedingt waren sehr viele Wespen unterwegs, was fast zu einem Unfall geführt hat, da eine Wespe unbemerkt in den Strohhalm gekrochen war. Alles in allem aber ein positives Erlebnis, werde wieder hingehen, wenn ich Mal in der Ecke bin
ownerResponseText:
Good afternoon, Ms. Schneider,

We are delighted that you enjoyed your meal and appreciated the friendliness of our service team. We understand that things can get a bit hectic when we are busy – we are constantly working to ensure a smooth experience even in such situations.

We take your comment regarding the table surface seriously and will look into it as soon as possible. We are very sorry about the wasp situation – unfortunately, this is a common problem in outdoor areas given the current weather conditions, but we will explore what additional measures we can take.

We would be pleased to welcome you back again on your next visit to our area.

Sincerely,
Your Restaurant Team
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Guten Tag Frau Schneider,

es freut uns, dass Ihnen unser Essen geschmeckt hat und Sie die Freundlichkeit unseres Serviceteams schätzen. Wir verstehen, dass bei hohem Gästeaufkommen manchmal eine gewisse Hektik entstehen kann – wir arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, auch in solchen Situationen einen reibungslosen Ablauf zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Anmerkung bezüglich der Tischoberfläche nehmen wir ernst und werden dies zeitnah prüfen. Die Wespensituation bedauern wir sehr – bei den aktuellen Wetterbedingungen ist dies leider ein allgemeines Problem im Außenbereich, dennoch werden wir schauen, welche zusätzlichen Maßnahmen möglich sind.

Wir würden uns freuen, Sie bei Ihrem nächsten Besuch in unserer Gegend wieder bei uns begrüßen zu dürfen.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Ihr Team vom Restaurant

text: The food and atmosphere were great, no complaints there. After 45 minutes, no one had appeared. It seems the Berlin Welcome Card program is being used to attract tourists. What a shame!

Nachdem wir dann ohne Rabatt zahlen wollten und nach einer Quittung verlangt haben, um dies an den Anbieter der Berlin Welcome Card weiterzugeben, war der Chef plötzlich doch da und es gab den Rabatt. text: The first time I tried the lamb curry, it wasn't anything special—just okay compared to other Indian lamb dishes I've had. We also had the samosas, which were good too, but nothing special. placeName: Wilde Matilde Deutsches Restaurant Cafe´ Bar und Variete
placeAddress: Wilde Matilde Deutsches Restaurant Cafe´ Bar und Variete, Rathausstraße 23, 10178 Berlin, Germany
placeDescription: Playful, offbeat spot for traditional cuisine, plus a large cocktail menu & a weekend variety show.
text:
We were very last-minute rebooked from Knutschfleck to Wilde Matilde because we were told the ventilation system at Knutschfleck had broken down. I had originally bought tickets for 12 people for my birthday.

Unfortunately, upon arrival, we were given three separate tables, and from our seats, we barely had a view of the show. My friends and I ended up pushing the tables together ourselves, making sure, of course, to leave enough space for the staff and performers.

The biggest problem, however, was the extreme heat inside. I've never sweated so much in a restaurant before. I had to go outside about every hour because it was actually more comfortable there. As a result, I couldn't enjoy my birthday evening and the show as much as I would have liked.

With a group of this size and a birthday in advance, I would have appreciated it if a table had been prepared for everyone to share.

However, I would like to emphasize that our waitress was wonderful. She was incredibly friendly and welcoming and immediately noticed that I wasn't happy with the table arrangements. Of course, she couldn't be held responsible for the organizational issues, and my criticism is expressly not directed at her.

I work in the restaurant industry myself and know that things can't always run perfectly when changes are made at short notice. Nevertheless, for me, proper organization is part of such an experience.

In the end, there were 11 of us, and we spent approximately €70 per person that evening. For that price, the overall experience unfortunately wasn't worth it for me personally. At around €70 per person, I would have expected more pleasant conditions, better table arrangements, and an overall experience where I didn't have to constantly go outside because of the heat.

My friends still had a good time, and I didn't want to let on that it was my birthday. In retrospect, however, I find it very disappointing that my birthday evening took place under these circumstances and that I wasted so much money on such a bad experience.
originalText:
Wir wurden sehr kurzfristig vom Knutschfleck in die Wilde Matilde umgebucht, da uns mitgeteilt wurde, dass die Lüftungsanlage im Knutschfleck ausgefallen sei. Für meinen Geburtstag hatte ich ursprünglich Tickets für 12 Personen gekauft.

Leider bekamen wir bei unserer Ankunft drei voneinander getrennte Tische und hatten von unseren Plätzen aus teilweise kaum Sicht auf die Show. Meine Freunde und ich haben die Tische schließlich selbst zusammengeschoben und dabei natürlich darauf geachtet, ausreichend Platz für den Service und die Künstler freizuhalten.

Das größte Problem war allerdings die extreme Hitze im Innenbereich. Ich habe noch nie in einem Restaurant so doll geschwitzt, wie hier. Ungefähr jede Stunde musste ich nach draußen gehen, weil es dort tatsächlich angenehmer war. Dadurch konnte ich meinen eigenen Geburtstagsabend und die Show leider nicht so genießen, wie ich es gerne getan hätte.

Bei einer Gruppe dieser Größe und einem angekündigten Geburtstag hätte ich mir außerdem gewünscht, dass ein gemeinsamer Tisch entsprechend vorbereitet wird.

Was ich allerdings ausdrücklich hervorheben möchte: Unsere Kellnerin war wundervoll. Sie war unglaublich freundlich und herzlich und hat direkt gemerkt, dass ich mit der Tischsituation nicht glücklich war. Für die organisatorischen Umstände konnte sie selbstverständlich nichts und meine Kritik richtet sich ausdrücklich nicht gegen sie.

Ich komme selbst aus der Gastronomie und weiß, dass bei kurzfristigen Änderungen nicht immer alles perfekt laufen kann. Trotzdem gehört für mich zu einem solchen Erlebnis auch eine entsprechende Organisation.

Wir waren letztendlich 11 Personen und haben an diesem Abend insgesamt ungefähr 70 € pro Person ausgegeben. Für diesen Preis war das Gesamterlebnis für mich persönlich leider nicht das Geld wert. Bei rund 70 € pro Person hätte ich mir angenehmere Bedingungen, eine bessere Tischorganisation und insgesamt ein Erlebnis gewünscht, bei dem ich nicht ständig wegen der Hitze nach draußen gehen muss.

Meine Freunde hatten trotzdem Spaß und ich wollte mir an meinem Geburtstag auch nichts anmerken lassen. Im Nachhinein finde ich es aber sehr schade, dass gerade mein Geburtstagsabend unter diesen Umständen stattgefunden hat und ich so viel Geld los bin für eine solche schlechte Erfahrung.

text:
An absolute highlight in Berlin! 💓

We had a fantastic time at Wilde Matilde! The restaurant is not only visually stunning with its colorful, playful, and unique decor, but it also completely won us over with its culinary offerings.

The food was truly indescribably delicious, from the hearty Berlin currywurst with crispy fries to the tasty Berlin Kassler served on a shovel. Everything was fresh, beautifully presented, and perfectly seasoned.

A very special thank you goes to our server, Isa! She was an absolute gem—incredibly warm, attentive, and cheerful.

Thanks to her wonderful service, we felt completely at ease from the very first moment.

We will definitely be back!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for super original food and a unique atmosphere in Berlin. 💓

Best regards from North Rhine-Westphalia
originalText:
Ein absolutes Highlight in Berlin!💓

Wir hatten eine fantastische Zeit in der Wilde Matilde! Das Restaurant ist nicht nur optisch ein absoluter Hingucker mit seiner bunten, verspielten und einzigartigen Einrichtung, sondern hat uns auch kulinarisch vollkommen überzeugt.

Das Essen war wirklich unbeschreiblich lecker  von der deftigen Berliner Currywurst mit knusprigen Pommes bis hin zu den leckeren Berliner Kassler auf einer Schaufel serviert. Alles war frisch, liebevoll angerichtet und geschmacklich auf den Punkt.

Ein ganz besonderes Dankeschön geht an unsere Bedienung Isa! Sie war einfach ein absoluter Schatz, unglaublich herzlich, aufmerksam und gut gelaunt.
Durch ihren tollen Service haben wir uns vom ersten Moment an rundum wohlgefühlt.
Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

Absolute Empfehlung für jeden, der super originelles Essen und eine einmalige Atmosphäre in Berlin sucht.💓

Liebe Grüße aus NRW

text:
The food and view are still something special. But the service on our last visit was a disaster. Despite having a reservation, we stood at the entrance for 15 minutes and were ignored by numerous hurried waitstaff.

Finally getting to our table, we received a menu after 20 minutes and were only able to order after 45 minutes. Until then, there were no drinks... no bread... and when we ordered, the server rattled off the menu... among other things, we ordered the unlimited water for the table. After the food and drinks were finally delivered, we were completely ignored by the staff. No one asked if we wanted more water; you had to be quite forceful to even get eye contact.

And yes, the food was very good – but the abysmal, completely overwhelmed service created no sense of even the slightest bit of attentiveness.

Things were very different when Neni was first established. All in all, it's a disappointment.
originalText:
Essen und Ausblick sind immer noch etwas Besonderes. Aber der Service war bei unserem letzten Besuch eine Katastrophe. Zunächst standen wir trotz Reservierung 15 Minuten am Eingang und wurden von vielen hektisch vorbei rennenden Service
-Kräften ignoriert. Dann endlich am Tisch angekommen, bekamen wir nach 20 Minuten eine Karte und konnten dann nach 45 Minuten erstmals bestellen. Bis dahin gab es keine Getränke… kein Brot… beim Bestellen dann ein kurzes Herunterleiern des Angebots der Servicekraft… unter anderem bestellten wir die Wasser-Flatrate für den Tisch. Nachdem das Essen und die Getränke einmal geliefert wurden, wurden wir von da an weiterhin vom Service ignoriert. Es gab keine Nachfragen, ob wir noch mal Wasser wollten, man musste sehr massiv werden, um einen Blickkontakt zu bekommen.
Und ja, das Essen war sehr gut – aber der unterirdische, völlig überforderte Service lässt kein Gefühl von minimal umsorgter Athmosphäre aufkommen.
Das war zur Gründungszeit des Nenis ganz anders. Aktuell unter dem Strich eine Enttäuschung.

Bundesbüdchen Restaurant Berlin, Hannoversche Str. 2, 10115 Berlin, Germany
text:
We spontaneously decided to dine at Bundesbüdchen on a Saturday evening and were able to easily reserve a table – after this experience, we honestly can't understand why the restaurant wasn't fully booked.

We ordered the chef's menu, and the food was absolutely fantastic. The fish and meat were of excellent quality, each course perfectly balanced and subtly seasoned – in our opinion, it was on par with a Michelin-starred restaurant. We also particularly appreciated the flexibility: since we didn't want dessert, we were able to easily swap it for the ravioli with shellfish bisque, which was also superb.

The wine recommendations were exceptionally good and intriguing. Although we initially hesitated to order the wine pairing, we ended up ordering three glasses – and they even kindly charged us the less expensive pairing instead of the individual wines.

The service was attentive, warm, and competent without ever being intrusive. I'm quite discerning when it comes to fine dining, but everything here was just right: product quality, cuisine, wine, service, and value for money. For us, it's a definite 12/10. We will definitely come back!
originalText:
Wir waren relativ spontan an einem Samstagabend im Bundesbüdchen und konnten problemlos noch einen Tisch reservieren – nach diesem Abend verstehen wir ehrlich gesagt überhaupt nicht, warum das Restaurant nicht komplett ausgebucht war.

Wir hatten das Chef’s Menu und das Essen war durchweg grandios. Fisch und Fleisch von exzellenter Qualität, jeder Gang perfekt ausbalanciert und raffiniert abgeschmeckt – für uns absolut auf Sternegastronomie-Niveau. Besonders toll fanden wir auch die Flexibilität: Da wir keine Nachspeise wollten, konnten wir diese unkompliziert gegen die Ravioli mit Krustentierbisque tauschen, die ebenfalls hervorragend waren.

Auch die Weinempfehlungen waren außergewöhnlich gut und spannend. Obwohl wir uns zunächst nicht für die Weinbegleitung entscheiden wollten, wurden es am Ende drei Gläser – netterweise wurde uns dafür sogar die günstigere Begleitung statt der einzelnen Weine berechnet.

Der Service war aufmerksam, herzlich und kompetent, ohne jemals aufdringlich zu sein. Ich bin bei gehobener Gastronomie wirklich anspruchsvoll, aber hier stimmt einfach alles: Produktqualität, Küche, Wein, Service und Preis-Leistung. Für uns eine absolute 12/10. Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

placeAddress: Bundesbüdchen Restaurant Berlin, Hannoversche Str. 2, 10115 Berlin, Germany
text: The two of us went there on Saturday evening and ordered one set menu (char, lamb, Black Forest cherry cake) and one à la carte dish (chanterelle soup, venison with mushrooms). We also had red wine and a non-alcoholic cocktail. The food was consistently very good, exactly as expected: aromatically well-balanced, expertly prepared, and all the ingredients cooked to perfection. The selection of wines by the glass was skillful, and the service was exceptionally good and knowledgeable about the wines. Very good value for money for Berlin (55 EUR for the three-course dinner, espresso 2.50 EUR). We had a wonderful evening and will definitely go back. Thank you to the friendly team!
originalText: Wir waren zu zweit am Samstag Abend dort und hatten einmal das Menü (Saibling, Lamm, Schwarzwälder Kirsch) und einmal à la Carte (Pfifferlingsuppe, Reh mit Pilzen). Dazu Rotwein und einen alkoholfreien Cocktail. Das Essen war solide sehr gut, exakt wie man es erwartet: aromatisch gut ausbalanciert, handwerklich sehr gut zubereitet, alle Produkte auf den Punkt gegart. Die Weinauswahl offener Weine gekonnt, der Service insgesamt ausgesprochen gut und kenntnisreich bei den Weinen.  Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis für Berlin (55 EUR für 3-Gang Menü abends, Espresso 2.,50 EUR). Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Abend und werden auf jeden Fall wieder hingehen, danke an das nette Team!

text:
Ok I’ll be honest - I really wanted to like this place. Heard good things, it looked good, but… firstly, there was very little atmosphere because the restaurant was nearly empty inside on a Friday night. It was really great to see the open kitchen and chefs at work but otherwise - all tables around us were empty. The staff was attentive but mixed up the ordered dishes amongst the people multiple times.
Food - it was tasty but it was not yummy. There was nothing I would tell my friends  about. the goulash was very salty, the portions felt uneven (the fish main size to the goulash was a 1:3 ratio). The deserts were tasty, but here again - the donut desert was significantly bigger than the others.

On the interiors - really loved the bar, the neon and the oldschool German feel it had but it’s a shame that the rest of the restaurant didn’t follow that theme - here, just like in the dishes, there wasn’t consistency. There is an idea behind this place but I really wish it was followed through more carefully.
ownerResponseText:
Hi Anna,

Thank you for your honest feedback. We appreciate it and value constructive feedback.

On this day we were booked out for a private function prior to evening service, making the turnover out of the ordinary.

Please note, our desserts, and all dishes for that matter, may appear different in size depending on their preparation. For example, a yeast-raised doughnut expands during frying, making it look larger, while our Chocolate Nemesis is denser and more indulgent. 

We appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts and hope to welcome you again some time!

Cheers.

placeAddress: Vedis Indisches Restaurant, Schönhauser Allee 142, 10437 Berlin-Bezirk Pankow, Germany
placeDescription: Organic tandoori dishes, spicy curries & cocktails in a relaxed space with red, orange & gold hues.
text:
Solid Indian cuisine on Schönhauser Allee with excellent service

A visit to Vedi's leaves a very positive overall impression. The dishes are delicious, and the value for money is excellent.

The dishes: Successful nuances with clear strengths

Mango Paneer: The Indian paneer was superbly prepared. However, the accompanying sauce would have benefited from a more pronounced fruit sweetness and a more intense mango flavor.

Mutton Korma: The lamb impressed with its tender texture and good quality. While the flavor deviated slightly from expectations, it was still quite tasty.

Drink highlights: The mango lassi was outstanding. The equally delicious mango milkshake proved to be a wonderful complement – ​​an excellent alternative for guests who prefer a less yogurt-heavy and less acidic refreshment.

Service & General Conditions
The service staff deserves special praise: When soup was mistakenly served at our table (without having been ordered from the lunch menu), they reacted with utmost courtesy and understanding. Four-legged companions are also welcome here.

Card payments are accepted without any problems. The only minor drawback is the restrooms – while acceptable, they could be a bit cleaner.

All in all, a pleasant spot on Schönhauser Allee that impresses above all with its friendly service and delicious refreshments.
originalText:
Solide indische Küche an der Schönhauser Allee mit hervorragendem Service

Ein Besuch bei Vedi's hinterlässt einen insgesamt sehr positiven Eindruck. Die Speisen überzeugen geschmacklich und das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist absolut stimmig.

Die Speisen: Gelungene Nuancen mit klaren Stärken

Mango Paneer: Der indische Rahmkäse war hervorragend zubereitet. Der dazugehörigen Sauce hätte eine deutlich ausgeprägtere Fruchtsüße und eine intensivere Mangonote allerdings sehr gut zu Gesicht gestanden..

Mutton Korma: Das Lammfleisch punktete mit zarter Textur und guter Qualität. Geschmacklich wich das Gericht zwar ein wenig von den geläufigen Erwartungen ab, war aber dennoch durchaus schmackhaft.

Getränke-Highlights: Der Mango Lassi glänzte auf ganzer Linie. Als wunderbare Ergänzung erwies sich zudem der ebenfalls sehr leckere Mango-Milkshake – eine hervorragende Alternative für Gäste, die eine weniger joghurtlastige und nicht so saure Erfrischung bevorzugen.

Service & Rahmenbedingungen
Ein besonderes Lob verdient das Servicepersonal: Als fälschlicherweise eine Suppe an den Tisch serviert wurde (ohne dass diese über die Mittagskarte geordert worden war), reagierte man äußerst zuvorkommend und kulant. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind hier willkommen.
Kartenzahlung ist problemlos möglich. Ein kleiner Abzug in der B-Note bleibt lediglich bei den Sanitäranlagen – diese sind zwar akzeptabel, lassen hinsichtlich der Sauberkeit jedoch noch ein wenig Spielraum nach oben.

Alles in Allem. Ein schöner Anlaufpunkt an der Schönhauser Allee, der vor allem durch sympathischen Service und gelungene Erfrischungen überzeugt.
ownerResponseText:
Dear Justin Jon Ensslen,

Thank you so much for your detailed and insightful feedback on your visit! We are delighted that you were so pleased with our Mango Paneer, the delicate Mutton Korma, and especially with our Mango Lassi and Mango Milkshake – we will gladly take your comment about the mango sauce on board as valuable feedback. The fact that our team was able to resolve the situation with the accidentally served soup so amicably and that you felt comfortable overall reinforces our commitment to excellent service, and we will, of course, take another close look at the cleanliness of our restrooms.

Vedi's Indian Restaurant | Indian Restaurant Berlin
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Lieber Justin Jon Ensslen,

vielen Dank für Ihre ausführliche und differenzierte Rückmeldung zu Ihrem Besuch bei uns! Es freut uns sehr, dass Sie mit unserem Mango Paneer, dem zarten Mutton Korma sowie besonders mit unserem Mango Lassi und Mango-Milkshake so zufrieden waren – Ihr Hinweis zur Mangosauce nehmen wir gerne als wertvollen Impuls auf. Dass unser Team die Situation mit der versehentlich servierten Suppe kulant lösen konnte und Sie sich insgesamt wohl gefühlt haben, bestärkt uns in unserem Anspruch an exzellenten Service, und wir werden selbstverständlich auch die Sauberkeit unserer Sanitäranlagen nochmals genauer in den Blick nehmen.

Vedi's Indian Restaurant | Indisches Restaurant Berlin

text:
Saravana Bhavan is a good option for South Indian food in Berlin, and the location is very nice. I have been to quite a few Saravanaa Bhavan restaurants across Europe, and I found this one to be noticeably more expensive than most of the others.

The dosa was excellent, as I have come to expect from Saravana Bhavan, and the buttermilk was also very good. The rasam, however, had far too much black pepper for my taste, which made it quite difficult to enjoy. I would have preferred a more balanced and traditional rasam.

Overall, the food was good and I would still recommend it. If you are in Berlin and looking for South Indian food, Saravana Bhavan is definitely worth a visit, although be prepared for slightly higher prices.

text: The food was served on metal plates, reminiscent of cafeteria food. placeDescription: Seasonal small plates & wine served in an intimate, industrial-style venue with a leafy terrace.
text:
The Berlin night belonged to Otto.

Some restaurants leave you with a memorable dish, others with an unforgettable evening.

Otto belongs to the latter.

Stepping inside, there's no lavish decor, no contrived sense of ceremony; the lighting, space, and open kitchen create a naturally comfortable rhythm.

The food continues this ambiance.

Each dish is simple, yet far from monotonous. Seasonal ingredients take center stage; the cooking time, sauces, and seasonings are just right, preserving the food's most authentic flavor.

I especially loved the seared salmon—crispy on the outside, tender on the inside; the lamb was perfectly cooked, soft and layered; and the dessert provided a comfortable ending to the evening.

On my travels, I've grown to love this kind of cuisine more and more.

Without any deliberate gimmicks, you can feel the chef's respect for the ingredients from the first bite to the last.

Perhaps the truly moving aspect of delicious food lies in its quiet dedication to doing everything perfectly, without rushing to prove anything.

Tonight, Berlin.

★★★★★ Worth a reservation, and worth a return visit.

The plating alone reveals the restaurant's "less is more" Scandinavian aesthetic: seared salmon, tender pork, grilled zucchini, seasonal lettuce, handmade bread and butter, culminating in dessert—each dish is clean and crisp, devoid of unnecessary embellishment, focusing the attention on the ingredients themselves.

I've also compiled reviews from various sources, and the positive feedback for Otto is remarkably consistent:

* Michelin Selected, emphasizing seasonal and modern cuisine, with a focus on seasonal, local ingredients, and influenced by Scandinavian cuisine.

* The service team is a highlight mentioned in many reviews—professional, friendly, and able to recommend dishes and wines based on guests' preferences.

* The open kitchen and sharing menu create a more interactive dining experience, making it suitable for groups.

* The wine list is of high quality, especially the selection of natural and orange wines, which are popular with many gourmets.

* With a Google rating of approximately 4.6/5 (over 600 reviews), many travelers consider it one of Berlin's most worthwhile restaurants to book.

* In recent reviews from many international gourmets, Otto has been rated as their favorite meal during their Berlin trip, praising the high quality of every dish and the very reasonable price compared to the quality.
originalText:
柏林的夜晚，留給了 Otto。

有些餐廳讓人記得一道菜，有些餐廳讓人記得整個晚上。

Otto 屬於後者。

走進店裡，沒有華麗的裝潢，也沒有刻意營造的儀式感，燈光、空間與開放式廚房，自然形成一種舒服的節奏。

餐點延續著這份氣質。

每一道菜都很簡單，卻一點也不單調。季節食材站在舞台中央，火候、醬汁與調味恰到好處，讓食物保有最真實的風味。

我特別喜歡那道炙燒鮭魚，外皮酥香，魚肉細嫩；羊肉熟度精準，柔軟而有層次；甜點則替今晚畫下很舒服的句點。

一路旅行，我越來越喜歡這樣的料理。

沒有刻意炫技，卻能讓人從第一口到最後一口，都感受到廚師對食材的尊重。

或許，美味真正動人的地方，就在於它不用急著證明什麼，只是安安靜靜地，把每一件事情做好。

今晚，柏林。

★★★★★ 值得預約，也值得再訪。

光是擺盤就能看出餐廳追求的是「少即是多」的北歐風格美學：炙燒鮭魚、粉嫩的豬肉、炭烤櫛瓜、季節生菜、手工麵包與奶油，再到最後的甜點，每一道都乾淨俐落，沒有多餘裝飾，把焦點放回食材本身。

我也整理了各方評論，發現大家對 Otto 的好評非常一致：

* 米其林指南推薦（Michelin Selected），主打季節料理與現代料理，以當季、在地食材為核心，帶有北歐料理的影響。
* 服務團隊是許多評論共同提到的亮點，專業、親切，能依照客人需求介紹餐點與酒款。

text: This was my fourth visit to Otto, and unfortunately, also my worst. During my previous visits, I always felt genuinely welcomed by a warm, enthusiastic team. This time, however, the experience was disappointing from the very beginning. At the reception, I was greeted by a dark-haired hostess who may have been overwhelmed by the number of guests, but her manner felt extremely robotic and impersonal. The interaction lacked warmth and natural communication, which immediately affected the atmosphere. I chose Otto to celebrate my birthday with my partner, who is vegetarian. I wanted to order the Chef's Menu, while he had to order à la carte because it is not possible to order the chefs Menu if you are vegetarian. and then we were told that I could not have the Chefs Menu because this  is intended to be shared. The explanation given was that having one guest order the tasting menu and the other order à la carte "doesn't work well for the kitchen." What made it even more disappointing is that I visited Otto alone about two years ago, ordered the Chef's Menu by myself without any issue, and had an unforgettable experience. Concerning the food, in this last visit, the food was nicely cooked, but extreme small portions and there was a big lack of information when it was served. The hospitality, flexibility, and overall atmosphere were completely different. Instead of feeling excited to celebrate a special occasion, I left feeling disappointed. The Otto I remembered was defined not only by excellent food but also by exceptional hospitality.

text:
Absolutely magical – the best Georgian experience in all of Berlin! 🇬🇪❤️

What an evening! Supra Berlin at Hackescher Markt isn't just a restaurant – it's a feast for all the senses and a true piece of Georgia right in the heart of the capital.

Even upon entering, you feel the warm, welcoming atmosphere. The ambiance under the S-Bahn arches is modern yet cozy, with a beautiful design that perfectly blends tradition and urban charm. But the highlight? The live shows! Traditional Georgian dances and music – pure energy and joy. You're instantly swept away and right in the middle of a real Supra celebration.

And the food… simply heavenly! The khachapuri, fresh from the oven, golden brown and with the creamiest cheese imaginable. The khinkali, juicy, aromatic, and handmade – pure perfection. The grilled specialties and the selection of appetizers were also absolutely delicious, fresh, and authentic. And then there were the fantastic Georgian wines – every sip a delight!

The service was attentive, friendly, and truly warm. You feel like a welcome guest at a large family celebration. The value for money is also excellent – ​​more than fair for this quality and overall experience.

I can wholeheartedly recommend Supra Berlin to anyone looking for authentic Georgian cuisine, great entertainment, and genuine hospitality. We will definitely be back – and soon! Thank you to the entire team for this unforgettable evening. Absolutely 5 stars and more! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

placeDescription: Inventive, multi-course menus & a huge global wine list in a contemporary space with rustic flair.
text:
You've ruined our lives…

(Please read to the end)

Eating at a Michelin-starred restaurant doesn't really fit our lifestyle or our budget. And yet, inspired and thrilled by the podcast, we reserved a table for our Berlin vacation.

Full of anticipation, we cycled to Fichtestraße and, since we were 20 minutes early, walked up and down the street.

Then the moment finally arrived:

As the weather was pleasant, we sat on the terrace and were immediately greeted very warmly and in the most pleasantly unpretentious way. After a refreshing hand towel and a glass of champagne as an aperitif, the first amuse-bouches arrived. And what can I say? From the first bite to the last, the meal was something I've never experienced before and will never forget. Yes, I've eaten many wonderfully executed dishes in a wide variety of restaurants, but what transpired on my palate and tongue during those four hours at Tulus Lotrek is, quite frankly, beyond words. Since I'd never tasted anything like it before, I simply lack the vocabulary to describe it. It's something you have to experience. And "experience" is the key word. It wasn't just a dinner. It was a four-hour, eight-course experience! The service was incredibly smooth, from refilling the water to serving each course with accompanying explanations—all without the need for formal culinary training or years of experience in Michelin-starred restaurants. It was pure, unpretentious ease. It was almost comforting that a few drops occasionally spilled during the enthusiastic refills.

And the sommelier—we unfortunately forgot to ask his name, but he's from Lindau :)—did an outstanding job. If you don't mention Michelin-starred cuisine, you also don't mention wine pairing. In other words, we were quite inexperienced in that area. But he handled it so effortlessly that we quickly felt comfortable. And the wine pairings for the courses were simply out of this world… Sparkling sake with a cocktail served on a plate of cucumber, rum, and lime? A match made in heaven.

Perhaps a few words about the food: For those who feel at home in Michelin-starred restaurants, it might be old hat – but for us, the combination of textures, mouthfeel, flavor combinations, imagination and creativity in the creation of the courses, and last but not least, the level of craftsmanship with which everything was brought to life, made for an unforgettable evening. How many dimensions can food have? Apparently, all of them! Which unfortunately brings me to my criticism – I think you've spoiled us and our palates a little… I'm afraid the only option is that this wasn't our last visit to Tulus Lotrek. Well… :D Finally, a thought for you, in case you're like us and have a hankering to try Michelin-starred cuisine, but are a little intimidated by some aspects. I can't imagine a better place for a "first time" than Tulus.

If I could give it 17 stars, I would!
originalText:
Ihr habt unser Leben versaut…

(bitte bis zum Ende lesen)

In einem Sternerestaurant essen zu gehen passt im Grunde weder zu unserem Lifestyle noch zur Größe unseres Geldbeutels. Und dennoch haben wir für unseren Berlin-Urlaub - inspiriert und begeistert vom Podcast - einen Tisch reserviert.
Sehr vorfreudig sind wir mit dem Fahrrad in die Fichtestraße gefahren und - da wir 20 Minuten zu früh waren - noch die Straße auf- und abgelaufen.

Dann war es endlich soweit:

Da das Wetter es zuließ, nahmen wir auf der Terasse Platz, wurden sofort sehr freundlich und auf positivste Weise unprätentiös empfangen. Nach dem Erfrischungstuch für die Hände und einem Champagner als Aperitif ging es auch schon los mit den ersten Grüßen aus der Küche. Und was soll ich sagen: Vom ersten bis zum letzten Bissen war das Essen etwas, was ich so noch nie erlebt habe und nie wieder vergessen werde. Ja, ich habe schon viele wundervoll gelungene Gerichte in verschiedensten Restaurants gegessen, aber was sich in diesen 4 Stunden im Tulus Lotrek an meinem Gaumen und meiner Zunge abspielte, ist ehrlich gesagt nicht in Worte zu fassen. Da ich so etwas noch nie geschmeckt hatte - fehlt mir schlichtweg das Vokabular es zu beschreiben. Das muss man erleben. Und Erleben ist das Stichwort. Es war nicht einfach nur ein Abendessen. Es war ein vierstündiges, achtgängiges Erlebnis!
Geschmeidigste Abläufe im Service, vom Wassernachschenken über das Servieren der Gänge mitsamt Erklärungen, für die man keine eigene Kochausbildung absolviert haben oder mehrere Jahre im Spiel der Sternegastronomie zu hause gewesen sein müsste. Eben Unprätentiösität durchgespielt. Da tut es fast gut, dass beim schwungvollen Nachschenken des Wassers auch mal der ein oder andere Tropfen daneben geht.
Und der Sommelier - leider haben wir vergessen nach seinem Namen zu fragen, aber er kommt aus Lindau :) - hat einen überragenden Job gemacht. Wer nämlich nicht Sternegastronomie sagt, sagt auch nicht Weinbegleitung. Sprich, an dieser Front waren wir auch sehr unerfahren. Das wurde aber von seiner Seite so spielerisch aufgefangen, dass wir uns schnell auch damit wohlgefühlt haben. Und die Pairings der Weine zu den Gängen, sind einfach von einem anderen Stern… Sparkling Sake zu einem Cocktail im Teller aus Gurke, Rum und Limette? Match made in Heaven.
Vielleicht doch noch ein paar Worte zum Essen: Für Personen, die sich in der Sternegastronomie zuhause fühlen, vielleicht ein alter Hut - für uns war die Mischung aus Texturen, Mundgefühl, Geschmackskombinationen, Fantasie & Kreativität in der Kreation der Gänge und nicht zuletzt das handwerkliche Niveau, auf dem alles zum Leben erweckt wurde - ein unvergesslicher Abend. Wie viele Dimensionen kann Essen haben? Offenbar alle!  Das bringt mich leider zur Kritik - ich glaube ihr habt uns und unsere Gaumen ein bisschen versaut… Ich fürchte die einzige Option ist, dass wir nicht zum letzten Mal im Tulus Lotrek gewesen sind. Naja… :D  Zu guter Letzt ein Gedanke für dich, falls es dir geht wie uns, du irgendwie Lust hast Sternegastronomie mal auszuprobieren, aber an der ein oder anderen Stelle großen Respekt davor hast. Ich kann mir keinen besseren Ort für ein „erstes Mal“ vorstellen, als das Tulus.

Könnte ich 17 Sterne geben - ich würde es tun!

After a promising start with appetizers and creative first courses (tuna, scallop, prawn), the menu took a significant turn for the worse with the main courses: goulash and pigeon. The signature dish, sweetbreads, was inexplicably more like a smaller version of a fast-food chain's chicken nugget than a "grown-up chicken nugget." Things improved again towards the end with the desserts, but overall, the meal left a rather unbalanced impression (far too sweet overall, everything rather bland, and the pigeon was a complete disappointment).

The drinks were certainly all special and carefully selected, but to be honest, we didn't really enjoy either the drinks or the wines. Perhaps it was just us, but somehow the drinks concept simply didn't appeal to us.



























... What really finished us off, though, was the severe stomach pain we had shortly after eating (which lasted for two days), and unfortunately, also a bit of disgust when we think back on the meal. This has never happened to us before, and it feels doubly strange considering the restaurant costs about a month's rent for a shared apartment. We firmly believe it was just a bad night, but our experience remains disappointing.
originalText:
Ich bin nachhaltig irritiert von unserem Besuch. Lange darauf gefreut, das Restaurant zu testen, aber leider ziemlich enttäuscht gewesen.

Nach einem schönen Start mit Häppchen und kreativen ersten Gängen (Thunfisch, Jakobsmuschel, Garnele) flachte das Menü bei den "Hauptspeisen" Gulasch und Taube signifikant ab. Das Signature Dish Kalbsbrieß war anstatt eines "Chicken Nugget für Erwachsene" unverständlicherweise eher der kleine Bruder vom großen Fastfood-Konzern. Hinten raus mit den Süßspeisen wieder besser, aber insgesamt hinterlässt das Essen einen ziemlich unausgewogenen Eindruck (ingesamt viel zu süß, alles relativ flach, die Taube überhaupt nix).

Die Getränke sind sicherlich alle besonders und mit viel Mühe ausgewählt, uns haben aber ehrlicherweise weder die Drinks noch die Weine wirklich geschmeckt. Vielleicht liegt das an uns, aber irgendwie hat uns das Getränkekonzept überhaupt nicht abgeholt.

Was uns dann aber den Rest gegeben hat, waren richtig ordentliche Bauchschmerzen kurz nach dem Essen (hielt 2 Tage an) und leider auch ein bisschen Ekel, wenn wir ans Essen zurückdenken. Das ist ist so in der Form noch nie passiert und fühlt sich bei einem Restaurant mit dem Preis einer Monatsmiete fürs WG-Zimmer doppelt komisch an. Wir glauben ganz fest daran, dass es nur ein schlechter Abend war, aber unsere Erfahrung bleibt leider enttäuschend.

text:
We had a fantastic evening at Tulus Lotrek in Berlin and are still absolutely thrilled! In short: It was incredibly delicious.

A particularly cool thing to note: We had actually wanted to eat here two years ago, but our reservation was canceled due to water damage and subsequent renovations. The fact that, two years later, on our second attempt, they immediately apologized with an aperitif and thanked us for giving it another try was incredibly kind. A truly wonderful and attentive welcome!

We also really enjoyed the music selection — Mucho Gusto 🍷

Culinary-wise, almost every single course was absolutely spot on and perfectly prepared. The flavors, the presentation – the cooking here is of the highest caliber. The only thing we personally didn't quite like was the sweet and salty bread. Unfortunately, there was no explanation for it, which made the whole thing a bit unappealing.



The food was also excellent. If we had to find something to criticize – and this is nitpicking at an extremely high level – it would be a few minor shortcomings in the service, considering the price. We paid just under €900 for two people. With that kind of budget, expectations were understandably very high. During one course, one of us briefly went to the restroom. During this time, the food and accompanying drinks were served without waiting or having the course properly explained to us again. With a total bill of almost €900, you'd expect the staff to be aware of such moments and provide the explanation for both of us afterward.

Aside from that, it was a truly fantastic evening and a real highlight. The food was flawless, with the exception of the bread. Despite the minor service mishaps, we're giving it a full 5 out of 5 stars – because the initial gesture and the food overall were simply amazing!
originalText:
Wir hatten einen fantastischen Abend im Tulus Lotrek in Berlin und sind immer noch absolut begeistert! Kurz gesagt: Es war super, super lecker.

Besonders cool vorab: Wir wollten eigentlich schon vor zwei Jahren hier essen, allerdings wurde unsere Reservierung damals wegen eines Wasserschadens und den anschließenden Renovierungen storniert. Dass man sich jetzt, zwei Jahre später, bei unserem zweiten Anlauf direkt mit einem Aperitif dafür entschuldigt und sich bedankt hat, dass wir es noch mal probiert haben, hat uns wahnsinnig gut gefallen. Ein wirklich toller und aufmerksamer Empfang!

Auch die Musikauswahl hat uns richtig gut gefallen — Mucho Gusto 🍷

Kulinarisch war fast jeder einzelne Gang wirklich voll on point und handwerklich perfekt zubereitet. Die Aromen, die Präsentation – hier wird auf allerhöchstem Niveau gekocht. Das Einzige, was uns persönlich geschmacklich irgendwie gar nicht gefallen hat, war das süß/salzige Brot. Dazu gab es leider auch keinerlei Erklärung, was das Ganze etwas unnahbar gemacht hat.

Wenn wir darüber hinaus etwas kritisieren müssten – und das ist Meckern auf extrem hohem Niveau –, dann betrifft es kleine Lücken im Service im Verhältnis zum Preispunkt. Wir haben für zwei Personen knapp 900 € bezahlt. Bei so einem Budget sind die Erwartungen natürlich verständlicherweise sehr hoch. Während eines Ganges war einer von uns kurz auf der Toilette. In dieser Zeit wurde das Essen und die begleitenden Getränke serviert, ohne dass gewartet oder uns der Gang danach noch einmal richtig erklärt wurde. Bei fast 900 € Gesamtrechnung erwartet man eigentlich, dass der Service solche Momente im Blick hat und die Erklärung für beide nachholt.

Davon abgesehen war es aber wirklich ein absolut geiler Abend und ein echtes Highlight. Das Essen war bis auf die kleine Brot-Ausnahme makellos. Trotz der kleinen Fauxpas beim Service geben wir volle 5 von 5 Sternen – weil die Geste zu Beginn und das Essen insgesamt einfach fantastisch waren!

text:
What an amazing experience! There are some moments in life that simply stay with you forever. Our evening at Tulus Lotrek will certainly be one of them. We're still buzzing with excitement from all the wonderful impressions, and just thinking about it brings back such a warm, fuzzy feeling.

There's really not much to say about the incredibly delicious food. Every single course was an explosion of flavor, with the Deichkind x Fettes Brot song "Give me more of that!" playing in my head.

What made the evening so incredibly special for us was the unbelievably warm hospitality. From the very first moment, we felt warmly welcomed and at ease. And then there were all the little touches, like the "special courses" for our youngest, who was having a bit of trouble with the menu. Or the charming attention to detail, like our names written in chalk on the table or the personalized menu cards. Then there were the many stories about each individual course, presented with such passion and pride, as if they were children you'd raised and were now releasing into the world, told in such a way that even our children enjoyed them. Unforgettable was Lino, who not only poured the perfect wine for each course but also spoke almost theatrically about its origin and flavor, waxing lyrical so enthusiastically that we couldn't wait to taste it each time. On top of that, he conjured up a number of special cocktails for us, even though they weren't on the menu.

And then there was the wonderful and charming Ilona with her unique warmth and loving nature, who made us feel as if we'd known each other for ages and were visiting friends. We would have gladly joined you at any time and invited you to our table to chat about anything and everything.

Of course, in the end, it's all about the food, and it was simply sensationally good. The greatest treasure of the Lotrekkies, however, is their boundless love for hospitality, which is palpable in every moment. We hope you know how wonderful you are. Please cherish this treasure.

Was für ein tolles Erlebnis. Es gibt so Momente im Leben, die bleiben einfach für immer in Erinnerung. Unser Abend im Tulus Lotrek wird ganz sicher dazugehören. Wir sind immer noch ganz beseelt von den vielen Eindrücken und allein die Gedanken an den Abend lösen ein unglaublich wohliges Bauchraumgefühl aus.

Über das oberleckere Essen braucht man eigentlich nicht viel zu sagen. Jeder einzelne Gang eine Schmecksplosion vom Feinsten mit permanentem Refrain von Deichkind x Fettes Brot "Gib mir mehr davon!" im Kopf.

Was den Abend für uns sooooooooo besonders machte, war einfach die unglaublich warmherzige Gastfreundlichkeit. Vom ersten Augenblick an fühlten wir uns herzlich aufgenommen und willkommen. Und dann die vielen kleinen Aufmerksamkeiten, z.B. die "Sondergänge" zwischendurch für unseren Jüngsten, der etwas "Startschwierigkeiten" mit der Menüfolge hatte. Oder die niedliche Detailverliebtheit, wie unser Name mit Kreidestift auf dem Tisch oder die persönlichen Menükarten. Dann die vielen Geschichten zu jedem einzelnen Gang, die man mit so viel Leidenschaft und Stolz darbietet, als wären es Kinder, die man groß gezogen hat und jetzt in die Welt entlässt und natürlich auch so erzählt, dass selbst unsere Kinder Spaß und Freude dran hatten. Unvergesslich auch Lino, der nicht nur zu jedem Gang einen perfekten Wein ausschenkte, sondern beinahe theaterreif über Herkunft und Geschmack zu berichten wusste und dabei so ins Schwärmen geriet, dass man es jedes Mal kaum erwarten konnte, zu probieren und obendrein eine Reihe Wunschcocktails für uns zauberte, obwohl diese eigentlich gar nicht auf der Karte standen.
Und dann noch die wundervolle und herzige Ilona mit ihrer einzigartigen Warmherzigkeit und liebevollen Art, die uns das Gefühl gab, als ob wir uns schon lange kennen würden und zu Besuch bei Freunden wären. Wir wären jederzeit gerne zusammengerückt und hätten dich an unseren Tisch gebeten, um über Gott und die Welt zu plaudern.

Natürlich geht es am Ende irgendwie ums Essen und das ist einfach auch sensationell gut. Der größte Schatz der Lotrekkies ist jedoch deren unbändige Liebe zum Gastgeber sein, die man in jedem Moment spürt. Wir hoffen, ihr wisst, wie toll ihr seid. Bitte bewahrt euch diesen Schatz.

placeAddress: tulus lotrek, Fichtestraße 24, 10967 Berlin, Germany
placeDescription: Inventive, multi-course menus & a huge global wine list in a contemporary space with rustic flair.
text:
Over the past decade, we have frequented numerous Michelin-starred establishments globally. Tulus Lotrek was the most anticipated stop of our recent Berlin trip. Unfortunately, the evening presented significant operational and culinary deficits, making it an unfortunate misallocation of time and resources given the city's rich dining opportunities.

FOOD
The tasting menu (239 euros) failed to meet the standard expected at this level due to technical execution flaws, notably underperforming on two typically reliable core courses: Carabinero and scallop. The Crudo: Akami lacked flavor definition, while the Carabinero and Sauce Bourride was poorly conceptualized. Topping a rich seafood dish with bitter chicory and radicchio leaves created an unsuccessful combination; the contrast was ineffective, resulting in a highly flawed preparation. Execution was also weak with the Scallop and Kumquat, which was overcooked and chewy, and the Burned Leek, which arrived over-burnt rather than skillfully charred. The sole exception was the Venison and Cherry Blossom, which was accurately cooked and cohesive. However, the dessert chapter, specifically the Brown Butter and Champagne, was unpalatable. The kitchen also fell short with the final Petit Four, serving an overcooked pastry that aligned with the evening's recurring theme of over-burnt elements.

SERVICE
The service was cold, robotic, and detached. We felt excluded from the room's atmosphere and the staff's focus, which is a clear shortcoming for a Michelin-starred establishment. Logistics and pacing were highly problematic. It took 30 minutes to receive the initial amuse-bouches, labeled as the "hello" section. This opening gesture was delivered slower than most restaurants' mid-dinner service, with zero staff engagement during the interim. When questioned, the staff offered a perfunctory, protocol-driven apology. No effort was made to rectify the delay, nor did anyone check on the table until the final bill. The stagnation was severe enough that mid-dinner, we considered requesting the bill early to pay full value and avoid wasting more time.

WINE SERVICE
The wine service lacked sharp intuition. The sommelier required an unusual amount of time and explanation to comprehend our preferred style and palate profile, a friction we did not encounter anywhere else on this itinerary.

AMBIANCE
The physical environment was uncomfortable. The dining room was excessively hot, and opening the windows in summer provided no practical relief. They also are writing the guest's name in massive lettering over the table. While intended as a hospitality gesture, its oversized execution compromised personal privacy. Peer restaurants execute this with far more subtlety; here, it felt like an artificial attempt to compensate for a lack of genuine warmth.

VALUE FOR MONEY
The value is poor. A 239 euro menu demands seamless execution and a high culinary standard. Spending an evening waiting excessive periods for poorly executed dishes in an uncomfortable room represents a failure in value delivery.

VERDICT
Unlike peer establishments where the margin between a great evening and a disappointing one is narrow, Tulus Lotrek underperformed fundamentally. It may appeal to affluent diners seeking a trendy Kreuzberg scene, or individuals looking simply to satisfy an appetite at a premium price point. However, it does not deliver an impactful culinary experience. Given the restaurant's reputation, it remains baffling how an acclaimed institution could deliver an experience so detached from standard hospitality, leaving the impression of a social experiment rather than a premier dinner.

text:
A truly wonderful evening! We had the pleasure of dining at the Chef's Table with wine pairings and were delighted from the first course to the last.

The dishes were superbly prepared, creative, and meticulously crafted. The wine pairings were excellently selected and complemented each course perfectly.

We were particularly impressed by the cohesive overall concept. The owner's handcrafted pottery perfectly complements the dishes and adds a special touch to the experience. The open fire, where some of the food is prepared, beautifully completes the concept and creates a unique atmosphere.

But what truly made the evening special was the warm hospitality. The entire team was attentive, friendly, and genuine. You feel welcome from the moment you arrive and simply have a fantastic time.

Even the restrooms are something special – exceptionally designed, original, and with great attention to detail. They, too, contribute to a complete experience that is thoughtfully planned down to the smallest detail.

Thank you for this unforgettable evening. Kramer is one of the best restaurant experiences we've ever had. We'll definitely be back!
originalText:
Ein rundum gelungener Abend! Wir hatten das Vergnügen, am Chef's Table mit Weinbegleitung zu sitzen und waren vom ersten bis zum letzten Gang begeistert.
Die Gerichte waren hervorragend zubereitet, kreativ und bis ins Detail durchdacht. Die Weinbegleitung war exzellent ausgewählt und hat sehr gut zu den einzelnen Gängen gepasst.
Besonders beeindruckt hat uns, wie stimmig das gesamte Konzept ist. Das vom Inhaber selbst gefertigte Geschirr aus eigener Töpferei passt perfekt zu den Gerichten und verleiht dem Erlebnis eine ganz besondere Note. Das offene Feuer, an dem ein Teil der Speisen zubereitet wird, rundet das Konzept wunderbar ab und schafft eine einzigartige Atmosphäre.
Was den Abend aber wirklich besonders gemacht hat, war die herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Das gesamte Team war aufmerksam, freundlich und authentisch. Man fühlt sich vom ersten Moment an willkommen und verbringt dort einfach eine großartige Zeit.
Und selbst die Toiletten sind etwas Besonderes – außergewöhnlich gestaltet, originell und mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Auch sie gehören zu einem Gesamterlebnis, das bis ins Kleinste durchdacht ist.
Vielen Dank für diesen unvergesslichen Abend. Das Kramer gehört für uns zu den besten Restauranterlebnissen, die wir bisher hatten. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
ownerResponseText:

text:
visited Mami's tonight with high expectations, but unfortunately it ended up being one of the most disappointing dining experiences I've had in Berlin.

Shortly after eating the pimientos de Padrón, I started experiencing stomach pain. I initially ignored it, but once we left the restaurant I asked my dinner companion if he was feeling okay, and he told me he was also having stomach pain. I can't say for certain what caused it, but it was concerning that we both felt unwell after the meal. Looking back, I wish I had mentioned it to the staff before leaving.

Beyond that, I found the prices extremely difficult to justify. For a summer tasting menu in Berlin, the food felt surprisingly heavy and lacked freshness. The pimientos de Padrón were among the worst I've had and were particularly disappointing.

I was also disappointed by the wine experience. The house recommendation turned out to be very sweet, something that should have been mentioned when it was presented. For a restaurant that positions itself around wine, I would also expect to be offered a small taste before committing to a glass. Instead, the whole experience felt underwhelming and didn't live up to the restaurant's concept.

The atmosphere also wasn't for me. The clientele and overall vibe felt more like a tourist trap than a restaurant offering a thoughtful dining experience.

The most disappointing part is that I had to cancel the rest of my evening because I felt so unwell after dinner. Instead of enjoying the night, I ended up going straight home and writing this review from my bed. Living nearby makes it even more disappointing, as I'll now always associate this place with a very unpleasant experience.

I'm sharing this because I genuinely hope the management takes feedback seriously. Whether our illness was related to the meal or not, the overall experience, from the food and wine to the value and atmosphere fell far below expectations. I hope improvements are made for future guests

text:
Unpleasant and overrated – how can the Michelin Guide still award this restaurant a star,

when anyone who doesn't adopt the often misguided opinion of the "sommelier" is practically bullied by him during their visit?

You don't get the four sips of wine for €100 served with the courses, but only when the "sommelier" happens to have the time and inclination?

While the culinary concept was once innovative, it's now implemented far more sophisticatedly (and, incidentally, much more affordably) in five or more restaurants in Berlin alone. And if you have your own vegetables in the garden, the fuss made over a piece of celery here seems like satire.

A Michelin-starred restaurant should offer friendly, courteous service to every guest. This is not the case at N&S due to the "sommelier's" behavior. He apparently prefers to invest his energy in fighting and deleting bad reviews rather than in improving himself.
