text:
We enjoyed the food, especially the risotto and chicken courses, although the chef tended to favor sour notes. We found it amusing when the waitress explained the “Brotzeit” first course, as if it was an avant-garde concept rather than the near ubiquitous (and sort of miserly) German practice of eating dark bread and cheese and butter for dinner.

The drinks program operated according to an idiosyncratic, and entrepreneurial, philosophy. The wine binder was as thick and impenetrable as a Dostoyevsky manuscript. Not that we had the time to look at it, as our waiter just barked things like “German or French!” “Dry?” “Are you ok with something a bit funky?” And ended up bringing us expensive bottles without ever indicating what the broader options were or what the price of anything was. This felt deliberate, given that the food waiter explained the chicken in so much detail that we practically knew its birth and death dates. The cherry on top came when my friend ordered a digestif. The drinks waiter barked “Fruit or herb?!” “Sweet or bitter!?” The bill revealed that the drinks waiter had lovingly selected an €80 digestif for our friend—roughly 2/3 of the price of the entire tasting menu—without ever mentioning the price.

My verdict: go if you can put it on your expense account. And order your drinks like you’re buying a used car.

Please get in touch at [dubist@nobelhartundschmutzig.com](mailto:dubist@nobelhartundschmutzig.com) or simply give us a call.

Best, 
Your Nobelharts

placeAddress: 136 Berlin Restaurant, Linienstraße 136, 10115 Berlin, Germany
text:
Peruvian-Italian cuisine sounds unusual at first, and that's precisely why we chose this restaurant. We were very curious to see if the concept could also deliver on flavor. And it definitely did.

Every single course was superbly coordinated, creative, and of a very high standard in terms of taste. Whether monkfish, Wagyu short rib, sauces, or essences, everything was incredibly refined, balanced, and prepared with meticulous attention to detail. The cuisine is undoubtedly the highlight and fully justifies the price point.

The interior is harmonious and fits the overall concept perfectly. The head chef deserves special mention; he personally visits the tables, explains the dishes, and is incredibly open, friendly, and charming. You can immediately sense the passion and dedication that has gone into this restaurant. The sommelier was also very attentive, knowledgeable, and open to feedback.

There is some room for improvement in the service. At times, there was a lack of attention, for example, when refilling wine and water glasses, setting the table, or with small details during the pouring process. Especially if the restaurant is aiming for a Michelin star, there's still room for improvement here.

Despite these minor shortcomings, we were very impressed with our evening overall. The quality of the food, the pleasant atmosphere, and above all, the charming personality of the chef make this restaurant a truly recommendable choice. The price-performance ratio is excellent, and we will definitely be back.
originalText:
Eine peruanisch italienische Küche klingt zunächst ungewöhnlich und genau deshalb haben wir uns für dieses Restaurant entschieden. Wir waren sehr gespannt, ob das Konzept auch geschmacklich überzeugen kann. Und das kann es definitiv.

Jeder einzelne Gang war hervorragend abgestimmt, kreativ und geschmacklich auf einem sehr hohen Niveau. Ob Seeteufel, Wagyu Short Rib, Soßen oder Essenzen, alles war unglaublich fein, ausgewogen und mit viel Liebe zum Detail zubereitet. Die Küche ist ohne Frage das große Highlight und rechtfertigt auch das Preisniveau vollkommen.

Das Interieur ist stimmig und passt sehr gut zum Gesamtkonzept. Besonders positiv hervorzuheben ist der Chefkoch, der persönlich an die Tische kommt, die Gerichte erklärt und dabei unglaublich offen, freundlich und charmant auftritt. Man merkt sofort, wie viel Leidenschaft und Herzblut hinter dem Restaurant steckt. Auch der Sommelier war sehr aufmerksam, kompetent und offen für Rückmeldungen.

Etwas Luft nach oben gibt es beim Service. Teilweise fehlte es an Aufmerksamkeit, etwa beim Nachschenken von Wein und Wasser, beim Eindecken des Bestecks oder bei kleinen Details während des Einschenkens. Gerade wenn das Restaurant einen Stern anstrebt, sollte hier noch etwas nachgebessert werden.

Trotz dieser kleinen Schwächen hat uns der Abend insgesamt sehr überzeugt. Die Qualität der Küche, die angenehme Atmosphäre und vor allem die charmante Art des Chefkochs machen das Restaurant zu einer echten Empfehlung. Das Preis Leistungs Verhältnis stimmt und wir werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.

text:
We ate at 136 for the first time last week and were absolutely delighted and impressed.

text:
We were there last Friday.

We had a reservation. We then waited for 40 minutes without the young waitress acknowledging us or any of the other guests. We finally got their attention and were able to order drinks and food after almost 45 minutes.

If we hadn't said anything, who knows when someone would have come.

Behind us was a loud group of men who addressed the waiters by name and were constantly served, while we still hadn't received our drinks after almost an hour. You couldn't call that a pleasant atmosphere. It would be nice if the waiters would say something, since they were hanging around chatting with those loud men the whole time and disturbing all the other guests.

And you could see that the other guests around us were also annoyed.

We've been here many times before, always before visiting the Friedrichstadt-Palast, which is directly across the street, but we probably won't be coming back now. What a shame.

The food was quite tasty, at least, and the portions were large.

placeAddress: YOU. Berlin, Charlottenstraße 52, 10117 Berlin, Germany
text:
We had our wedding reception at Heritage last year. It was an absolutely perfect evening, superbly organized by Anna Sefrin and brilliantly executed by her team! I've already written a review about it.

As a tradition, we'll now eat here every year on our wedding anniversary. Yesterday was the first time. :-)

We had, of course, reserved a table in advance and were truly touched that they decorated our chosen table with paper hearts and invited us for a glass of Crémant upon arrival. I think that's really exceptional, especially these days. Everyone on the staff knew the reason for our visit and congratulated us. Just like last year, we immediately felt welcome and comfortable. Fantastic!

The food was, as expected, very good. Yes, a three-course meal is also expensive and perhaps borderline pricey, but in our opinion, the quality is commensurate.

The restaurant itself is beyond compare. For me, it's one of the most beautiful restaurants in Berlin and beyond!

The service is, in our opinion, perfectly balanced between the necessary courtesy one expects at this level and a very pleasant, understated informality. This creates a thoroughly comfortable atmosphere. Yes, as some have criticized, the staff aren't at our table every two minutes, but we don't need that. I prefer it this way to being constantly asked if we'd like another glass of wine, etc. Ultimately, it's a matter of taste, but for us, it works very well.

We enjoyed another wonderful evening at the Heritage and would therefore like to extend our sincere thanks to the service team, the chefs, and Anna.

By the way, anyone planning a family celebration at the Heritage should be in excellent hands with Anna Sefrin. She was one of the reasons we chose the Heritage as our wedding venue.
originalText:
Wir hatten letztes Jahr unser Hochzeitsessen im Heritage. Das war ein rundum perfekter Abend, top von Anna Sefrin organisiert und super umgesetzt von ihrem Team! Eine entsprechende Rezension hatte ich bereits geschrieben.

Als Tradition werden wir nun jedes Jahr an unserem Hochzeitstag hier essen gehen. Gestern war das erste Mal.  :-)

Wir hatten den Tisch natürlich vorher reserviert und waren wirklich gerührt, dass man uns unseren Wunschtisch mit Papierherzen dekoriert und uns zum Empfang auf ein Glas Crémant eingeladen hat. Ich finde gerade in der heutigen Zeit ist das wirklich außergewöhnlich. Jeder im Service wusste von dem Anlass unseres Besuchs und gratulierte uns. Wir haben uns, wie damals, sofort willkommen und wohl gefühlt. TOP!

Das Essen war wie erwartet sehr gut. Ja, es ist bei einem Drei-Gänge-Menü auch kostenintensiv und möglicherweise grenzwertig, hat jedoch auch die entsprechende Qualität, wie wir persönlich finden.

Die Räumlichkeiten sind über jeden Zweifel erhaben. Für mich eines der schönsten Restaurants in Berlin und darüber hinaus!

Der Service ist für unseren Geschmack perfekt ausbalanciert zwischen der notwendigen Höflichkeit, die man auf dem Niveau erwartet, und einer sehr angenehmen, nicht übertriebenen "Lockerheit". So entsteht für uns eine rundum wohlige Atmosphäre. Ja, die Mitarbeiter sind, wie manche kritisiert haben, nicht alle 2 Minuten am Tisch, aber wir brauchen das auch nicht. Das ist mir so lieber, als wenn man andauernd gefragt wird, ob man nicht doch noch ein Glas Wein etc. möchte. Am Ende Geschmacksache, für uns passt das sehr gut.

Wir haben erneut einen sehr schönen Abend im Heritage genossen und möchten uns daher auch beim Service-Team, den Köchen und Anna sehr herzlich bedanken.

Übrigens, wer mal eine Familienfeier im Heritage erleben möchte ist bei Anna Sefrin in besten Händen. Sie war einer der Gründe, warum wir uns damals als Hochzeitslocation für das Heritage entschieden haben.

YOU. Berlin, Charlottenstraße 52, 10117 Berlin, Germany
text:
I wrote to the restaurant directly after my stay but unfortunately never received a reply. Therefore, here is my review.

Hello Heritage Team,

I gave my girlfriend a voucher for breakfast, which we redeemed this morning.

Even the greeting was impersonal and curt. The colleague who greeted me was unfriendly and annoyed throughout our entire stay, and her tone with her colleagues was inappropriate, especially when guests could hear it.

In a hotel of this caliber, the velvet furniture shouldn't have so many stains.

I researched the location thoroughly before choosing it and therefore expected a very good breakfast, which one would expect for €38.

Unfortunately, the breakfast did not meet our expectations.

The selection of egg dishes is good. We opted for the Eggs Benedict. However, the hollandaise sauce was curdled.

The bread selection is also good, but it's a shame that the pastries aren't homemade. Especially the cake!

It would be better to offer less, but make it all homemade.

The cheese selection was particularly disappointing!

No hard cheeses, sheep's cheese, or goat's cheese.

Consequently, the jams were pointless.

None of the spreads were homemade.

Liverwurst in plastic?

The only fish was salmon.

The fruit salad wasn't freshly made; the only freshly cut fruit was pineapple.

There were absolutely no highlights on the buffet.

In my opinion, coffee and tea should be served in a hotel of this price range, and even better would be if the coffee came from an espresso machine with hand-frothed milk.

Finally, the Crémant should be mentioned, which neither of us liked at all.

For a total of €100 for two people, it was a disappointing experience; we've eaten much better elsewhere.

What a shame.
originalText:
Ich habe dem Restaurant direkt geschrieben nach meinem Aufenthalt aber leider nie eine Antwort erhalten. Deshalb nun hier meine Bewertung.

Hallo Heritage Team,

Ich habe meiner Freundin einen Gutschein für das Frühstück geschenkt, den wir am heutigen Morgen eingelöst haben.

Schon die Begrüßung war unpersönlich und schnippisch. Die Kollegin, die mich in Empfang genommen hat war während unseres ganzen Aufenthalts unfreundlich, genervt und  ihr Umgangston mit ihren Kollegen ist unangemessen vor allem, wenn die Gäste es hören.

In einem Haus dieser Kategorie, sollten die Samtmöbel nicht so viele Flecken aufweisen.

Ich hatte mich bei der Auswahl der Location umgehend informiert und bin somit von einem sehr guten Frühstück ausgegangen, was man bei 38€ auch erwarten darf.
Leider hat das Frühstück nicht unsere Erwartungen erfüllt.

Die Auswahl der Eier Speisen ist gut. Wir haben uns für das Egg Benedikt entschieden. Die Sauce Hollandaise war allerdings geronnen.
Die Brotauswahl ist auch gut, allerdings ist es schade, dass das Gebäck nicht hausgemacht ist. Vor allem der Kuchen!
Lieber weniger anbieten, dafür aber hausgemacht.

Besonders enttäuschend  ist  die Käseauswahl!
Keinerlei Hartkäse,  Schafskäse oder Ziegenkäse.
Demzufolge machen die Marmeladen dazu keinen Sinn.
Die Aufstrich sind alle nicht hausgemacht.
Leberwurst in Plastik?
Fisch, einzig Lachs.
Der Obstsalat ist nicht frisch gemacht, das einzige frisch aufgeschnittene Obst war Ananas.
Es gab überhaupt keine Highlights auf dem Buffet.

Aus meiner Sicht sollte in einem Hotel dieser Preiskategorie auch der Kaffee und Tee serviert werden und noch besser wäre es, wenn der Kaffee aus einer Siebträger Maschine kommt, mit Hand aufgeschäumter Milch.

Zum Schluss sei noch der Cremant erwähnt, der uns beiden überhaupt nicht geschmeckt hat.

Für insgesamt 100 € für zwei Personen, ein enttäuschendes Erlebnis, wir haben an anderen Orten schon viel besser gegessen.
Schade.

text:
This was my favorite restaurant for the past five years, but sadly, it's no longer my favorite.

I ate here today with a friend. The menu is definitely not as extensive or as good as it used to be. There are far fewer dishes than before.

We ordered the same dish and asked for our leftovers (which were almost a full plate) to be packed together in a box.

However, we only received a small box that was at most half full. What was previously on the plate was barely a third of what was left, even with a generous interpretation. It makes no sense to throw away most of the food that's already been paid for and only give the paying customer a small portion.

So, SOY has unfortunately lost its place as my favorite restaurant.

The decor has also deteriorated. It used to look much nicer.

Update:

I see that the owner only responded to my review with "🧢". That's slang for expecting me to lie. Because of this reaction, I'm reducing my rating from 2 to 1 star.

I had at least expected a respectful and understanding response. Instead, being indirectly portrayed as a liar after expressing my disappointment with my visit is deeply disappointing and unacceptable. This is especially bitter for me because this restaurant was my favorite for many years, and I told everyone how good it was.
originalText:
War jetzt für 5 Jahre mein lieblings Restaurant jetzt leider nicht mehr.

Ich war heute zu zweit hier essen. Die Karte ist definitiv nicht mehr so groß und gut wie sie zuvor war. Viel weniger Gerichte als damals.

Wir haben das gleiche Gericht gegessen und haben am Ende unsere Reste (die schon fast ein voller Teller waren) zusammen in eine box einpacken lassen.

Bekommen haben wir aber nur eine kleine box die maximal zur Hälfte gefüllt waren. Das was zuvor auf dem Teller war ist nur noch mit Augen zudrücken zu einem Drittel drin gewesen. Es macht keinen sinn dieses bereits bezahlte essen größtenteils wegzuwerfen und dem bezahlenden Kunden nur noch ein kleinen Teil zu geben.

Den Platz als Lieblings Restaurant hat das SOY somit leider verloren.

Es wurde auch die Dekoration verschlechtert. Früher sah es schöner aus.

Update:

Ich sehe, dass der Inhaber auf meine Bewertung lediglich mit "🧢“ geantwortet hat. Das ist ja slang dafür das ich lügen soll. Aufgrund dieser Reaktion reduziere ich meine Bewertung von 2 auf 1 Stern.

Ich hatte zumindest mit einer respektvollen und verständnisvollen Antwort gerechnet. Stattdessen indirekt als Lügner dargestellt zu werden, nachdem ich meine Enttäuschung über meinen Besuch geschildert habe, empfinde ich als sehr enttäuschend und inakzeptabel. Besonders bitter ist das für mich, da dieses Restaurant über viele Jahre hinweg mein Lieblingsrestaurant war und ich jedem darüber erzählt habe wie gut es ist.
ownerResponseText:
Yes, I responded with the 🧢.

Not because I wanted to attack you personally, but because the claim that we deliberately threw away a large portion of your already paid-for food is truly outrageous.

And to be honest, with this accusation, you've definitely secured a spot in our top three for "Cap of the Year." Not because we mind criticism of the menu or the decor—opinions on that are certainly subjective. But because the claim that we intentionally throw away our guests' food is both absurd and damaging to our reputation.

We don't stand for that sort of thing, neither as a restaurant nor as individuals.

After five years as your supposed favorite restaurant, we honestly expected fair criticism rather than such accusations.
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Ja, ich habe mit dem 🧢 geantwortet.

Nicht, weil ich Sie persönlich angreifen wollte, sondern weil die Behauptung, wir hätten einen Großteil Ihres bereits bezahlten Essens absichtlich weggeworfen, wirklich wild ist.

Und ich will ehrlich sein: Mit dieser Unterstellung haben Sie sich auf jeden Fall einen Platz in unseren Top 3 für den „Cap des Jahres“ gesichert. Nicht, weil uns Kritik an der Karte oder der Deko stört, darüber kann man unterschiedlicher Meinung sein. Sondern weil die Behauptung, wir würden absichtlich Essen unserer Gäste wegschmeißen, gleichzeitig absurd und rufschädigend ist.

Für so etwas stehen wir weder als Restaurant noch als Menschen. 

Nach fünf Jahren als angebliches Lieblingsrestaurant hätten wir ehrlich gesagt eher mit fairer Kritik gerechnet als mit derartigen Unterstellungen.

placeAddress: Rutz, Chausseestraße 8, 10115 Berlin, Germany
placeDescription: Chic dining venue with creative, international dishes prepared by renowned chef Marco Müller.
text:
Dining at Rutz was, without question, an experience that demonstrates remarkable technical skill, creativity and precision. The restaurant has created an elegant and refined atmosphere, with a sophisticated dining room that immediately conveys why it has earned its Michelin recognition. The service team is attentive, professional and passionate.

However, there were aspects of the experience that prevented it reaching the exceptional standard I anticipated.

Throughout the evening there was a large number of staff involved in serving each course. While each server was courteous and knowledgeable, the constant rotation of servers made the experience feel fragmented. Different people would arrive to present, serve, clear or explain dishes, which at times became confusing rather than seamless. Fine dining should feel effortless and cohesive, but on this occasion the service felt over choreographed.

The cuisine is unquestionably imaginative and technically accomplished. Every plate resembled a carefully curated work of art, with meticulous presentation and evident attention to detail. However, there were several courses where the pursuit of artistic expression outweighed the enjoyment of the food itself. While visually captivating, dishes lacked depth of flavour and came across as restrained. Delicacy is one thing, but there were moments where subtlety crossed into blandness, leaving me wishing for more balance between visual creativity and taste.

I found the storytelling surrounding the dishes somewhat underdeveloped. Modern Michelin dining often succeeds because each course tells a story, whether about regional heritage, the chef’s philosophy, local producers or the inspiration behind the composition. At Rutz, many of the presentations felt limited to a straightforward description of the ingredients, essentially explaining what was on the plate rather than why it mattered. I had hoped to gain a greater appreciation of the history, cultural significance or creative journey behind each course. A richer narrative would have transformed the meal from an impressive technical display into a more emotionally engaging experience.

The wine pairing was another element that left mixed impressions. It began exceptionally well, with the opening selections complementing the early courses beautifully. The progression felt thoughtful, balanced and enhanced both the food and the wines themselves. Midway through the menu, however, the pairing lost direction. Some wines felt disconnected from the dishes, making the overall progression less coherent. Fortunately, the final stages of the pairing regained their focus, concluding with some excellent selections that restored confidence in the overall concept and provided a memorable finish to the evening.

Overall, Rutz undoubtedly deserves recognition for its innovation, technical execution and ambition. It offers an experience that many diners will admire, particularly those who appreciate culinary experimentation and artistic presentation.

For me, however, the evening highlighted that exceptional fine dining is about more than technical perfection. The most memorable restaurants create harmony between flavour, storytelling, service and atmosphere. While Rutz excels in creativity and craftsmanship, I left feeling that greater emphasis on flavour, more cohesive service and richer narratives behind each course would elevate the experience from impressive to truly unforgettable.

I would also encourage the restaurant to provide greater clarity during the reservation process regarding the €600 payment. It was not immediately apparent that this amount functions as a booking fee rather than being credited towards the final account. Clearer communication at the outset would help manage guests’ expectations.

With a total expenditure of €1,544 for the evening, I anticipated an experience that was exceptional in every respect. Unfortunately, I left still feeling hungry and, despite recognising the considerable technical skill and creativity involved, ultimately underwhelmed and disappointed.

text:
My wife and I dined at the Rutz wine bar last night and opted for the inspirational menu with eight wine pairings.

The evening began with an amuse-bouche that immediately set a high standard: finely sliced ​​potato cubes drizzled with a marjoram emulsion, accompanied by a drinking bowl filled with beef stock. This small dish, with its complexity, precision, and rich flavor, was the first highlight of the evening.

However, we found the flow of the following 60 minutes less than ideal. The first courses were served in what we felt was a very rapid succession. At times, the next wine was poured even before the previous one was nearly finished. This created a feeling of hecticness that significantly detracted from our enjoyment. Only after I explicitly requested that the pace be slowed did the rhythm ease.

The food itself was, for the most part, of a very high standard. The dishes were imaginative, unusual, and complexly composed without seeming arbitrary. With one exception, the wine pairings harmonized beautifully with each course. The young waitress who served us and the sommelier deserve special mention. Both were exceptionally friendly and attentive, and explained each course and wine with great expertise.

We were somewhat disappointed by the "Handschrift" course, consisting of aged and dried beef with wild mushrooms and lichen, accompanied by sliced ​​hazelnuts and a beef broth. The beef itself was first-rate and sliced ​​paper-thin, but its appearance strongly reminded me of carpaccio. The granules of wild mushrooms, lichen, and grated beef were rather subdued in flavor; the hazelnuts were the dominant flavor. It's important to emphasize that we certainly enjoyed the dish, but compared to the preceding courses, it lacked the same complexity and depth of flavor.


We were somewhat disappointed by the "Handschrift" course, consisting of aged and dried beef with wild mushrooms and lichen, accompanied by sliced ​​hazelnuts and a beef broth. The following dishes were once again very impressive. The seared carrot with chicken skin and tarragon was particularly striking. The chicken skin was located inside the carrot, creating a surprising yet perfectly harmonious flavor. The lamb dish with wild garlic was also well-balanced. The lamb itself was beautifully pink, though a little too firm for my personal taste.

To conclude, we were served three desserts. The strawberry with lemon balm and the pear with oxalic acid and koji mushroom were superbly prepared and once again demonstrated the kitchen's precision and creativity. The final dessert, however, was noticeably disappointing: a wild rose granita infused with pine needle and sandalwood essences. Unfortunately, these gave the dessert a slightly unpleasant, bath-like quality.

In summary, it was a wonderful evening with cuisine of impressive quality. The dishes were almost consistently excellent, creatively composed, and harmoniously presented. A few courses, particularly the aged beef and the wild rose granita, fell somewhat short of the high standard set by the rest of the menu, in our opinion. However, our most significant criticism wasn't directed at the kitchen, but rather at the initially rushed service. Once the pace was adjusted, we were able to enjoy a much more relaxed evening.

Overall, the service team was very friendly, attentive, and professionally competent. The explanations of the dishes and wines, in particular, enhanced the evening. Despite these minor shortcomings, the Rutz wine bar remains, for us, a place of great culinary ambition where we have experienced many memorable moments.

Meine Frau und ich waren gestern Abend in der Weinbar Rutz essen und haben uns für das Inspirationsmenü mit acht Gläsern Weinbegleitung entschieden.

Der Abend begann kulinarisch mit einem Amuse-Gueule, das sofort Maßstäbe setzte. Ein fein in Scheiben geschnittener Kartoffelwürfel, beträufelt mit einer Majoran-Emulsion, dazu eine Trinkschale mit einem Auszug aus Rinderfond. Dieses kleine Gericht war in seiner Komplexität, Präzision und Geschmacksfülle das erste Highlight des Abends.

Weniger gelungen empfanden wir allerdings den Ablauf der folgenden etwa 60 Minuten. Die ersten Gänge wurden für unser Empfinden in sehr rascher Folge serviert. Teilweise wurde bereits der nächste Wein eingeschenkt, obwohl der vorherige noch nicht annähernd ausgetrunken war. Dadurch entstand bei uns ein Gefühl von Hektik, das den Genuss deutlich beeinträchtigte. Erst nachdem ich ausdrücklich darum gebeten hatte, das Tempo zu reduzieren, entspannte sich der Rhythmus.

Kulinarisch zeigte sich der Abend überwiegend auf sehr hohem Niveau. Die Gerichte waren phantasievoll, ausgefallen und komplex komponiert, ohne dabei beliebig zu wirken. Auch die Weinbegleitung harmonierte bis auf eine Ausnahme sehr schön mit den einzelnen Gängen. Besonders positiv hervorzuheben ist die junge Mitarbeiterin, die uns die Speisen servierte, sowie die Sommelière. Beide waren ausgesprochen freundlich, engagiert und erklärten die einzelnen Gänge und Weine mit großer Sachkenntnis.

Etwas enttäuscht waren wir vom Gang Handschrift, bestehend aus gereiftem und getrocknetem Rind mit Waldpilz und Flechte, dazu in Scheiben geschnittene Haselnüsse sowie eine Rinderbrühe. Das Rind selbst war erstklassig und hauchdünn geschnitten, erinnerte mich in der Anmutung jedoch stark an Carpaccio. Das Granulat aus Waldpilzen, Flechten und geraspeltem Rind blieb geschmacklich eher zurückhaltend; im Wesentlichen dominierten die Haselnüsse.  Wichtig ist zu betonen, das Gericht hat uns durchaus geschmeckt, aber im Vergleich zu den vorangegangenen Gängen fehlten ihm die gleiche Vielschichtigkeit und Geschmackstiefe.

Die folgenden Gerichte überzeugten uns dann wieder sehr. Besonders eindrucksvoll war die Sandkarotte mit Broilerhaut und Estragon. Die Broilerhaut befand sich im Inneren der Karotte und sorgte für eine überraschende, zugleich sehr stimmige Aromatik. Auch das Lammgericht mit Waldlauch war gut ausbalanciert. Das Lamm selbst war schön rosa gebraten, für meinen persönlichen Geschmack allerdings ein wenig zu fest.

Zum Abschluss folgten drei Desserts. Die Erdbeere mit Melisse sowie die Birne mit Oxalsäure und Kojipilz waren hervorragend zubereitet und zeigten erneut die Präzision und Kreativität der Küche. Das letzte Dessert fiel für uns dagegen spürbar ab, ein Granité mit Wildrosen, dem eine Fichtennadel-Essenz sowie Sandelholzessenz beigegeben war. Diese verlieh dem Dessert leider eine Note von Badezusatz.

Zusammenfassend war es ein sehr schöner Abend mit einer Küche von beeindruckender Qualität. Die Speisen waren fast durchgehend hervorragend gearbeitet, kreativ und stimmig komponiert. Einzelne Gänge, insbesondere das gereifte Rind und das Wildrosen-Granité, blieben aus unserer Sicht etwas hinter dem hohen Niveau der übrigen Menüfolge zurück. Der deutlichste Kritikpunkt betrifft jedoch nicht die Küche, sondern den anfänglich zu hektischen Serviceablauf. Nachdem das Tempo angepasst wurde, konnten wir den Abend wesentlich entspannter genießen.

Das Serviceteam war insgesamt sehr freundlich, aufmerksam und fachlich überzeugend. Besonders die Erläuterungen zu den Speisen und Weinen haben den Abend bereichert. Trotz kleiner Schwächen bleibt die Weinbar Rutz für uns ein Ort großer kulinarischer Ambition, an dem wir viele beeindruckende Momente erlebt haben.

text:
We visited here a few weeks back with friends to celebrate my convocation night, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences we've had in the city. If you are looking for a completely vegetarian restaurant with top-tier hygiene and genuine Indian flavors, this is hands down the best spot. Everything we tried, including the palak sabzi, was rich, flavorful, and incredibly well-prepared.
The highlights were definitely the Sev Puri and Manchurian (both pictured in my attached photos). Tasting their Sev Puri after years felt like being transported straight back to Mumbai for an authentic chaat experience that is so hard to find in Germany. The Manchurian was so delicious that after having it during our main course, we actually ordered a second portion at the end as our "dessert"—one portion filled our bellies, but definitely not our hearts!
While it is slightly on the higher end in terms of price, it isn't overly expensive for the quality and overall experience you get. Every single penny spent here felt soul-touching and 100% worth it. If you want pure vegetarian food with authentic taste in Berlin, this place is absolutely worth visiting.

inattentive. a waitress came to us to “explain” their menu (completely unnecessary there is nothing remarkable about their menu or grills),  their lecture on the three kinds of meat they had was embarssing as the waitress had nothing of interest to say about the food except to push their wagyu on us and upsell us. she taught us how to grill the meat and warned us that food often falls through the grill. the grill was something i have never seen before across eating bbq in the west, korea and japan. the slits in the grill were ridiculously oversized for the pathetic portions they dole out and it was an electric grill which made for a inferior taste as opposed to gas or charcoal as the meat was cooked inconsistently and the waitstaff had no advice as how to maintain a consistent cook. no side dishes are included with your meal and each plate of meat is cut incredibly thin. our rice was overcooked and mushy and side dishes are overpriced. the meat was mediocre and the quality of the beef was hindered by the shitty grill. there were no asian customers dining in beside myself (figures) because people who eat asian bbq regularly know better than to waste their time. the price of the meat would have been forgivable if the quality matched up but the side dishes were poorly seasoned don’t expect anything as they can’t even manage a pot of rice. as soon as our meat was finished a waitress dashed over to turn our grill off, presumably so they could turn our table over to the next customers or save on electricity. as we were eating the last piece of food the waitress was itching to turn our grill off,  this was the only time we received any attention from the staff. the  dessert menu was pathetic it all looked pretreated and freezer stable. i doubt they have a real kitchen as opposed to a team of people who empty ziplocks of preprepared food onto faux asian plates. food is bad, grill is cheap, staff are rude, portions are abysmal, prices are delusional.

text:
It was a unique culinary journey with a diverse range of flavors. The service was very personal, almost friendly, without being intrusive.

We felt right at home from the moment we stepped into the restaurant.

Upon entering, you can see into the open kitchen. The overall design is very open, airy, warm, and timeless.

We ordered both the vegan and the fish eight-course menus, which, considering the quality of the food, the sophistication, the service, and the time we spent there (3.5 hours), were more than reasonably priced.

We would also like to commend the beverage pairings (one alcoholic and one non-alcoholic). The non-alcoholic pairings, in particular, were absolutely exceptional and unique, so we were eager to discover what flavor would come next with each course.

Each course is served on handcrafted ceramics made by the owner, emphasizing the connection to nature and the uniqueness of the food and the overall concept.

We will never forget this visit and hope to return soon.

Thank you again to the entire team.
originalText:
Es war eine einmalige kulinarische Reise mit verschiedensten Geschmäckern. Der Service war sehr persönlich, fast freundschalftlich, ohne dabei zu aufdringlich zu sein.
Wir haben uns beim ersten Schritt in das Lokal wie zu Hause gefühlt.
Gleich beim Eintreten kann man in die offene Küche schauen. Generell ist alles sehr offen, luftig, warm und zeitlos gestaltet.
Wir haben einmal das vegane und einmal das Fisch-8-Gänge Menü bestellt, das preislich angesichts der Qualität der Speisen, der Raffinesse, des Servicees und der dort verbrachten Zeit (3,5h), mehr als angebracht war.
Ebenso möchten wir die Getränkebegleitung (1x alkoholische und 1x alkoholfreie) positiv hervorheben. Gerade die alkoholfreien war absolut außergewöhnlich und einmalig sodass wir bei jedem Gang aufs neue gespannt gewesen sind, welcher Geschmack und wohl als nächstes erwartet.
Jeder Gang wird wird auf handgefertigter Keramik der Eigentümererin angerichtet und unterstreicht so die Naturverbundenheit und Einzigartigkeit der Speisen und des Konzepts.

Wir werden diesen Besuch wohl nie vergessen und hoffentlich bald wieder kommen.

Vielen Dank nochmals an das gesamte Team.
ownerResponseText:

vielen Dank für die überschwengliche Bewertung. Wir freuen uns voller Leidenschaft auf jeden Abend, den wir für die Gäste unvergesslich machen können. Sie haben recht: die Naturverbundenheit bringt alles zusammen. :)
Herzlich
Jinok Kim

placeAddress: Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer, Unter den Linden 77, 10117 Berlin, Germany
placeDescription: Elegant restaurant with creative cuisine, as well as views of the Brandenburg Gate.
text:
Lorenz Adlon Essimer, a two-Michelin-star fine dining restaurant located in the heart of Berlin overlooking the Brandenburg Gate, embraces influences and ideas from across Europe while actively incorporating Asian sensibilities into its modern fine dining.

The flavors and textures harmonize across the 6, 7, and 8-course tasting menus, featuring dishes such as sea bass with chicory, kohlrabi, and orange, and wild turbot with grapefruit, celery, and hazelnut. Duck liver, its various variations, and sour cream also showcase the kitchen's confident craftsmanship.

The restaurant's elegant wood-paneled dining room exudes class and the luxury of the classic world, reflecting Adlon's rich history. Past guests include Thomas Edison, Henry Ford, and John D. Rockefeller.

placeDescription: Loungey venue with a patio spotlighting imaginative cocktails & small plates, plus seasonal fare.
text:
Yesterday we visited the Kink's beer garden. At reception, we were asked to repeat our request for a table in English. I don't want to get used to the fact that you can almost only get by with English in Berlin's restaurants these days.

The location is very nice, but unfortunately, the staff was very inattentive and slow. It's also not very appetizing when the waiters cough into their hands and then serve.

The food was a mixed bag. The appetizer of bread, olives, and chanterelles was good in terms of quality and taste, but the bread, in particular, is questionable in terms of price.

The main course (grilled beef) was more than disappointing: cold, and about a third of the meat was sinewy and gristly. The fries tasted good, but seemed more like leftovers from a bag—more like small broken pieces than nice, long fries. We would have liked some vegetables as a side dish, but unfortunately, that wasn't on the menu.
... The wine prices are ambitious (starting at €50 per bottle), but our wine was very good (Albarino from Bodegas y Vinedos Attis). We had to ask for ice cubes several times.

Our criticism of the food was not well received; in fact, it was dismissed almost rudely.

Unfortunately, there's a significant gap between expectations and execution. It's a shame, as the location is beautiful and deserves better.
originalText:
Wir haben gestern des Sommergarten des Kink besucht. Am Empfang wurden wir gebeten unsere Frage nach einem Platz nochmals auf englisch zu wiederholen. Das man in Berlins Gastro fast nur noch mit englisch weiterkommt, daran möchte ich mich nicht gewöhnen.

Die Location ist sehr schön, das Personal leider sehr unaufmerksam und langsam. Zudem ist es nicht appetitlich, wenn sich die Kellner in die Hand husten und dann servieren.

Das Essen war durchwachsen. Die Vorspeise mit Brot, Oliven und Pfifferlingen qualitativ und geschmacklich gut, aber gerade beim Brot kann man sich darüber streiten, ob dieser Preis angemessen ist.

Der Hauptgang (Rind vom Grill) war mehr als enttäuschend, kalt und ca. 1/3 des Fleisches sehnig und knorpelig. Die Pommes waren geschmacklich gut, aber wirkten eher wie der Rest aus der Tüte, also eher kleine Bruchreste denn schöne lange Pommes. Gerne hätten wir dazu etwas Gemüse als Beilage gehabt, aber so etwas steht leider nicht auf der Karte.

Die Weinpreise sind ambitioniert (ab 50 € pro Flasche), aber unser Wein war sehr gut (Albarino von Bodegas y Vinedos Attis). Die Bitte nach Eiswürfeln mussten wir mehrfach adressieren.

Die am Essen geäußerte Kritik wurde nicht gut aufgenommen, sondern fast schon pampig abgetan.

Leider klafft hier eine große Lücke zwischen Anspruch und Ausführung. Schade, die Location ist sehr schön und hätte mehr verdient.

A great place with a fantastic, traditional atmosphere!
The braised pork knuckle was absolutely delicious – juicy, perfectly seasoned, and melt-in-your-mouth, and the charred skin was absolutely delicious. The beer the waiter recommended was simply amazing.
A big plus for the children's friendly approach: the nuggets for the kids were delicious, and the entire staff was incredibly kind, efficient, and very helpful.
I highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious food in Berlin!

Thank you :)
originalText:

Duży plus za podejście do najmłodszych: nuggetsy dla dziecka okazały się wyśmienite, a cała obsługa była przemiła, sprawna i bardzo pomocna.
Gorąco polecam każdemu, kto szuka pysznego, jedzenia w Berlinie!

Dziękujemy :)

text:
From the very first moment, BOM captivated me with its unique atmosphere. Here, modern, urban Kreuzberg flair blends seamlessly with a singular warmth that's rare to find these days. The ambiance is stylish yet cozy – perfect for leaving the everyday world behind.

The menu is a true masterpiece: creative, diverse, and brimming with high-quality, fresh ingredients. Every dish tastes of genuine passion and craftsmanship. I was particularly impressed by the perfectly balanced flavors and the loving presentation. The drinks menu boasts a selection of fine wines and original cocktails that will delight every palate.

The staff shines with friendliness, expertise, and a palpable joy in hospitality. You truly feel like a welcome guest here, not just a customer.

Whether for a relaxed dinner, a special evening with friends, or a romantic date – BOM is the place to be in Kreuzberg. For me, this restaurant is already an absolute favorite and a true hidden gem. A must-visit for anyone who appreciates fine dining and authentic Berlin lifestyle!

Highly recommended – everything here is just perfect!
originalText:
Vom ersten Moment an hat mich das BOM mit seiner unverwechselbaren Atmosphäre begeistert. Hier verbindet sich modernes, urbanes Kreuzberg-Flair mit einer einzigartigen Herzlichkeit, die man heutzutage selten findet. Das Ambiente ist stilvoll und gleichzeitig gemütlich – perfekt, um den Alltag hinter sich zu lassen.
Die Speisekarte ist ein wahres Meisterwerk: Kreativ, abwechslungsreich und voller hochwertiger, frischer Zutaten. Jedes Gericht schmeckt nach echter Passion und Handwerk. Besonders beeindruckt haben mich die perfekt ausbalancierten Aromen und die liebevolle Präsentation. Die Getränkekarte überzeugt mit ausgewählten Weinen und originellen Cocktails, die jedem Gaumen Freude bereiten.
Das Personal glänzt durch Freundlichkeit, Kompetenz und eine spürbare Freude am Gastgeben. Man fühlt sich hier wirklich als willkommener Gast, nicht nur als Kunde.
Ob für ein entspanntes Dinner, einen besonderen Abend mit Freunden oder ein romantisches Date – das BOM ist der Place-to-be in Kreuzberg. Für mich ist dieses Lokal bereits jetzt ein absoluter Favorit und ein echter Geheimtipp. Pflichtbesuch für alle, die Genuss und authentische Berliner Lebensart schätzen!
Absolute Empfehlung – hier stimmt einfach alles!

text: My husband and I had a wonderful dinner at Rocoto on Saturday evening – 100/10. We started with the Trio de Ceviches, which was absolutely outstanding, simply wow. The tuna tacos were also fantastic. For our main courses, we chose the halibut with mussels and the duck on risotto. Both were incredibly refined in flavor. The dessert (crème caramel with fresh fruit) was the perfect ending. The portion sizes were excellent, the service was very attentive, and we really enjoyed the restaurant's atmosphere. We will definitely be back, thank you!
originalText: Mein Mann und ich hatten am Samstagabend ein wundervolles Abendessen im Rocoto - 100/10. Wir hatten als Vorspeisen das Trio de Ceviches und es stach über allem hervor, einfach wow. Auch die Thunfisch Tacos waren klasse. Für den Hauptgang wählten wir den Heilbutt mit Miesmuscheln und die Ente auf Risotto. Beides geschmacklich sehr raffiniert. Auch das Dessert (Creme Caramel mit frischen Früchten) war ein perfekter Abschluss. Die Positionsgrößen sind 1A, der Service sehr bemüht und die Atmosphäre des Restaurants hat uns auch sehr gefallen. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder, Gracias!

placeDescription: Laid-back restaurant with exposed-brick walls offering traditional Peruvian cuisine & cocktails.
text:
1st Visit (2 people):
Given the many positive reviews, we went to Rocoto with high expectations and were not disappointed. Friendly staff and excellent food. We will definitely come back.

2nd Visit (6 people):
After our positive experience on our first visit, we planned another visit with friends for a relaxed Saturday evening. Reservations weren't possible directly with the restaurant but had to be made through a reservation portal. I generally find it acceptable that restaurants struggling with capacity charge for reserved tables, although I still consider the €20 per person charged here to be quite steep. However, the fact that establishments like this one, where people queue outside to get a table, participate in this practice really calls the fundamental principle of the system into question.

I also found the time slot system disappointing. You go to a restaurant like this, which isn't exactly cheap, to enjoy a good meal, have a pleasant evening, and unwind at the end of the day. Nevertheless, despite ordering a large amount, having to wait a bit longer for our food, and leaving a generous tip, we were politely ushered out of the restaurant at the end of our allotted time. The impression of being treated like a conveyor belt customer is unavoidable. Do you really need to do that? I don't think so.

Upon returning home, I was asked by the reservation platform ZENCHEF.com to rate the visit – which I did, giving it 4 out of 5 stars for the reasons stated above. However, the review apparently wasn't published, and we unfortunately received no response from the restaurant.

All in all, even though the food was tasty, we probably won't be visiting this restaurant again. You can enjoy a good meal and spend your money in a more relaxed atmosphere at other restaurants.
originalText:
1. Besuch (2 Personen):
Angesichts der vielen guten Bewertungen gingen wir mit großen Erwartungen ins Rocoto und wurden nicht enttäuscht. Freundliches Personal und hervorragendes Essen. Wir werden in jedem Fall wieder kommen.

2. Besuch (6 Personen):
Nach unseren guten Erfahrungen beim 1. Besuch, planten wir zusammen mit Freunden, für einen gemütlichen Samstagabend, einen weiteren Besuch. Die Reservierung war nicht über das Restaurant selbst möglich, sondern musste über ein Reservierungsportal vorgenommen werden. Das Restaurants mit Auslastungsproblemen, für freigehaltene Plätze Gebühren verlangen, finde ich grundsätzlich ok, wobei ich trotzdem die hier aufgerufenen 20 EUR pro Person schon als sehr sportlich empfinde. Dass aber Lokale wie dieses, bei dem die Leute, um einen Platz zu ergattern, vor der Tür Schlange stehen, sich an dieser 'Praxis' beteiligen, stellt den Grundgedanken des Systems doch schon sehr in Frage.

Schade fand ich auch die Zeitfenster-Regelung. Man geht in ein solch nicht unbedingt günstiges Lokal, um gut zu Essen, einen schönen Abend zu verleben und den Tag ausklingen zu lassen. Dennoch wurden wir - trotz das wir ausgiebig, bestellten, teils etwas länger auf das Essen warten mussten, und üppiges Trinkgeld gaben - zum Ende des Zeitfensters, aus dem Restaurant herauskomplimentiert. Der Gedanke des Fließbandkunden drängt sich somit auf. Habt ihr das wirklich nötig? Ich denke nicht.

Zu Hause angekommen wurde ich von der Reservierungsplattform ZENCHEF.com gebeten, den Besuch zu bewerten - was ich auch, mit o.a. Begründung mit 4 von 5 Sternen tat. Die Bewertung wurde jedoch scheinbar nicht veröffentlicht, eine Rückmeldung vom Lokal erhielten wir leider auch nicht.

Alles in allem werden wir das Lokal, auch wenn das Essen schmeckte, wohl nicht mehr besuchen. Gut essen und dafür Geld ausgeben gehen kann man auch unaufgeregter in anderen Lokalen.

text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

What an evening at Chiaro in the Hotel de Rome!

From the very first moment, it was simply perfect – stylish, relaxed, yet sophisticated. The service is exactly what you'd hope for: unobtrusive yet always present, attentive, warm, and genuine. You immediately feel welcome.

The cuisine is a highlight in itself – creative, honest, and incredibly delicious. You can taste the passion and love that goes into every bite. The chefs truly give their all, and you can feel it in every single bite.

The bar is also absolutely top-notch – fantastic cocktails, exclusive spirits, and a team that truly knows their craft. The perfect end to a wonderful evening.

A special thank you to Peggy, the heart and soul of the place. She's everywhere, creating a wonderful atmosphere, charm, and that very special feeling of well-being – Chiaro wouldn't be the same without her.


The food is creative, authentic, and incredibly delicious. And last but not least: a shout-out to the best doorman in town – friendly, professional, simply legendary.

In short: Great team, great food, great drinks. Berlin at its best. 👏
originalText:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Was für ein Abend im Chiaro im Hotel de Rome!
Vom ersten Moment an einfach rund – stylisch, entspannt und trotzdem mit Klasse. Der Service ist genau so, wie man ihn sich wünscht: unaufdringlich, aber immer da, aufmerksam, herzlich, echt. Man fühlt sich sofort willkommen.

Die Küche ist ein Highlight für sich – kreativ, ehrlich, unfassbar lecker. Man schmeckt, dass hier mit echter Leidenschaft und Liebe gekocht wird. Die Köche geben wirklich alles, und das spürt man in jedem Bissen.

Auch die Bar ist absolut top – tolle Cocktails, exklusive Spirituosen und ein Team, das sein Handwerk versteht. Der perfekte Abschluss eines großartigen Abends.

Ein besonderes Dankeschön an Peggy, die gute Seele des Hauses. Sie ist überall, sorgt für Stimmung, Charme und diesen ganz besonderen Wohlfühlfaktor – ohne sie wäre das Chiaro nicht dasselbe.

Und nicht zu vergessen: ein Gruß an den besten Doorman der Stadt – freundlich, professionell, einfach Kult.

Fazit: Großartiges Team, großartiges Essen, großartige Drinks. Berlin at its best. 👏

Authentic Italian food and excellent service

A wonderful Italian restaurant with a clear focus on quality rather than quantity. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared, making it clear that great ingredients are a priority here.

The service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming from start to finish.

The prices are very reasonable for both the quality of the food and the location. Situated right next to the TV Tower on a pedestrian-only square, you can enjoy your meal without the noise of traffic, which creates a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for authentic Italian food in the heart of Berlin!

placeAddress: Restaurant Keyser Soze - Berlin, Tucholskystraße 33, 10117 Berlin, Germany
placeDescription: Laid-back venue for all-day breakfast, plus schnitzels & salads, as well as afternoon cake & coffee.
text:
On August 1st, I went to Keyser Soze with a friend to grab a bite to eat and enjoy the rest of the evening outside.

When we ordered, we were informed that we would either have to move inside or leave by 10 pm – which was perfectly fine with us.

However, what we found unacceptable was that the staff cleared away the table decorations as early as 9:35 pm. At 9:45 pm, the bill was brought to us without us even asking, while we were still in the middle of eating.

The food was also disappointing. The tomato soup was very thick and, unfortunately, completely unappealing in terms of taste. The baguette served with it was stale and dry.

I don't even want to mention the dirty restroom – it unfortunately contributed to the overall disappointing experience.

It's a shame, because the restaurant actually has a nice atmosphere. However, the service made us feel like they were just rushing us through. Combined with the disappointing food quality, it unfortunately didn't make for a pleasant dining experience.
originalText:
Ich war am 01.08. mit einer Freundin im Keyser Soze und wollte dort noch eine Kleinigkeit essen und den Abend draußen ausklingen lassen.

Bereits bei der Bestellung wurden wir darauf hingewiesen, dass wir um 22 Uhr entweder nach drinnen wechseln oder gehen müssten – das war für uns völlig in Ordnung.

Was wir allerdings nicht akzeptabel fanden: Schon um 21:35 Uhr räumte das Personal die Tischdekoration ab. Um 21:45 Uhr wurde uns ungefragt die Rechnung gebracht, obwohl wir noch mitten beim Essen waren.

Auch das Essen war enttäuschend. Die Tomatensuppe hatte eine sehr dicke Konsistenz und konnte geschmacklich leider überhaupt nicht überzeugen. Das dazu servierte Baguette war alt und trocken.

Über die schmutzige Toilette möchte ich eigentlich gar nicht erst reden – sie passte leider zum insgesamt enttäuschenden Eindruck.

Schade, denn die Gastronomie hat eigentlich eine schöne Atmosphäre. Der Service vermittelte uns jedoch das Gefühl, möglichst schnell abgefertigt zu werden. Zusammen mit der enttäuschenden Essensqualität war das leider kein angenehmer Restaurantbesuch.

text: Veronika was one of the most unique dining experiences we had in Berlin. I’d recommend it if you want to experience Berlin’s vibe, not if you’re looking for traditional comfort food.

text:
We spontaneously decided to come here yesterday because of the seasonal menu. Since I've now reached over 1.3 million people with my restaurant and establishment reviews, I have to say this was absolutely the best redfish I've ever eaten, especially with the sauce from the seasonal menu, and we've tried a lot of restaurants. They were truly working their magic here. There was definitely a high-quality kitchen at work. The combination of ingredients—the spinach, the sauce, and the fish—was absolutely superb.

We also had the chicken skewers, which were served normally. Typical, with potatoes and a little salad, definitely not bad, but not the highlight compared to the fish. I will definitely come back here and try another special dish next time, and then we'll see if they can replicate the experience.

Unfortunately, the pictures, due to the open umbrellas and the yellow and red decor, are a bit washed out and don't really do justice to the beautiful presentation of the food.
originalText:
Wir waren hier gestern spontan und haben uns aufgrund von der Saison Auswahl niedergelassen. Da ich nun mehr als 1,3 Millionen Personen erreicht habe mit den Bewertungen in Restaurants und Einrichtung , muss ich sagen absolut den besten Fisch Rotbarsch in dem Fall mit der Soße aus der Saison Karte, den ich je gegessen habe und wir haben sehr viele Restaurants getestet. Hier wurde absolut gezaubert. Definitiv war hier ein Rezept von einer hochwertigen Küche im Spiel. Die Kombination aus den Zutaten den Spinat der Sauce und dem Fisch absolut super.

Des Weiteren hatten wir noch die Hähnchenspieße, die normal serviert wurden. Typisch mit Kartoffeln bisschen Salat definitiv nicht schlecht aber eben auch nicht im Vergleich zu den Fisch das Highlight, ich werde hier definitiv wieder herkommen und mir dann auch noch mal ein spezielles Gericht rauszusuchen dann schauen wir ob das Ganze so wiederholt werden kann.

Leider sind die Bilder aufgrund der offenen Schirme durch das gelb-rote Design etwas ausgeglichen in der Farbe und Stellen leider nicht die tolle Abrichtung  der Speisen da.

placeAddress: Hallmann und Klee, Böhmische Str. 13, 12055 Berlin-Bezirk Neukölln, Germany
placeDescription: Innovative, seasonal dishes in a chic, airy venue best known for its breakfast & brunch offerings.
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We visited a Michelin-starred restaurant for the first time on **July 23, 2026**, and honestly, we couldn't have chosen a better place.

From the moment you step into Hallmann & Klee, you can tell that the people who work here love their job. You feel welcome from the very first moment, not like a guest who has simply reserved a table.

Sarah Hallmann is ever-present – ​​close to the guests and right in the thick of things. Her warm, natural manner is infectious and, together with the entire team, creates an atmosphere where you immediately feel at ease. The service is attentive, professional, and pleasantly relaxed. Every course and every drink is presented with palpable passion, without ever seeming forced.

The menu was a true journey of discovery for us. Each course had its own character, yet everything came together to form a harmonious whole. We were particularly impressed by how even seemingly simple ingredients like potatoes or a Hawaiian toast could be transformed into something extraordinary. You can taste the creativity, the craftsmanship, and above all, the attention to detail in every single dish. Each course was perfectly balanced, full of surprising flavors, and prepared with a precision that never ceased to amaze us. The dishes never felt overloaded, but rather clear, harmonious, and meticulously thought out down to the smallest detail.

We were equally impressed by the beverage pairings. We opted for both the wine pairing and the non-alcoholic option. To be honest, we had expected the drinks to simply complement the food. In fact, they were an integral part of the experience. Each pairing seemed to enhance the flavors of the dishes, revealing new facets and further elevating the enjoyment. The selection was exceptionally discerning, creative, and perfectly coordinated. We have never before experienced such a sophisticated beverage pairing – both with and without alcohol.

We also loved the ambiance. The restaurant's design is deliberately understated, and that's precisely what gives it its charm. Nothing distracts from what truly matters: the people, the cuisine, and the shared culinary experience.

Many thanks to Sarah Hallmann, the entire service team, and the kitchen for this wonderful evening. If this was our first visit to a Michelin-starred restaurant, then you've set the bar incredibly high. We'll be thinking about this evening for a long time and will definitely be back.

Finally, a recommendation for anyone who might feel the same way we did: If you've had any reservations about fine dining, just let them go. Trust the team at Hallmann & Klee and embrace this experience. It's not about navigating a supposedly exclusive world, but about being welcomed with genuine warmth and enjoying exceptional cuisine. For us, there couldn't have been a better place to take our first step into the world of Michelin-starred dining.
originalText:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Wir waren am **23.07.2026** zum ersten Mal in einem Sternerestaurant und ehrlich gesagt hätten wir uns keinen besseren Ort dafür aussuchen können.

Schon beim Betreten des Hallmann & Klee merkt man, dass hier Menschen arbeiten, die ihren Beruf lieben. Man fühlt sich vom ersten Moment an willkommen und nicht wie ein Gast, der einfach nur einen Tisch reserviert hat.

*Sarah Hallmann* ist dabei ständig präsent – nah am Gast und mitten im Geschehen. Ihre herzliche, natürliche Art steckt an und schafft gemeinsam mit dem gesamten Team eine Atmosphäre, in der man sich sofort wohlfühlt. Der Service ist aufmerksam, professionell und dabei angenehm ungezwungen. Jeder Gang und jedes Getränk werden mit spürbarer Leidenschaft präsentiert, ohne dabei jemals aufgesetzt zu wirken.

Das Menü war für uns eine echte Entdeckungsreise. Jeder Gang hatte seinen eigenen Charakter und dennoch ergab am Ende alles ein stimmiges Ganzes. Besonders beeindruckt hat uns, dass selbst scheinbar einfache Zutaten wie Kartoffeln oder ein Toast Hawaii zu etwas Außergewöhnlichem werden können. Man schmeckt die Kreativität, das handwerkliche Können und vor allem die Liebe zum Detail in jedem einzelnen Teller. Jeder Gang war perfekt ausbalanciert, voller überraschender Aromen und mit einer Präzision zubereitet, die uns immer wieder staunen ließ. Die Gerichte wirkten dabei nie überladen, sondern klar, harmonisch und bis ins kleinste Detail durchdacht.

Mindestens genauso begeistert waren wir von der Getränkebegleitung. Wir hatten sowohl die Weinbegleitung als auch die alkoholfreie Variante gewählt. Ehrlich gesagt hatten wir erwartet, dass die Getränke einfach gut zu den Speisen passen würden. Tatsächlich waren sie aber ein gleichwertiger Teil des Menüs. Jede einzelne Begleitung schien die Aromen der Gerichte weiterzuerzählen, neue Facetten hervorzubringen und den Genuss noch einmal zu steigern. Die Auswahl war außergewöhnlich sensibel, kreativ und perfekt abgestimmt. Eine so raffinierte Getränkebegleitung – sowohl mit als auch ohne Alkohol – haben wir bisher noch nicht erlebt.

Auch das Ambiente hat uns sehr gefallen. Das Restaurant ist bewusst schlicht gestaltet und genau das macht seinen Charme aus. Nichts lenkt vom Wesentlichen ab: den Menschen, der Küche und dem gemeinsamen Genusserlebnis.

Vielen Dank an Sarah Hallmann, das gesamte Serviceteam und die Küche für diesen wunderbaren Abend. Wenn dies unser erster Besuch in einem Sternerestaurant war, dann habt ihr die Messlatte verdammt hoch gelegt. Wir werden noch oft an diesen Abend denken und kommen ganz bestimmt wieder.

Zum Schluss noch eine Empfehlung an alle, denen es vielleicht so geht wie uns: Falls ihr bisher Berührungsängste mit der Sternegastronomie hattet, legt sie einfach ab. Vertraut euch dem Team von Hallmann & Klee an und lasst euch auf dieses Erlebnis ein. Hier geht es nicht darum, sich in einer vermeintlich exklusiven Welt zurechtzufinden, sondern darum, mit echter Herzlichkeit empfangen zu werden und außergewöhnliche Küche zu genießen. Für uns hätte es keinen besseren Ort geben können, um den ersten Schritt in die Welt der Sternegastronomie zu machen.

We had made a reservation based on reviews. As soon as we arrived, we were told unkindly that they don't take reservations; in the end, we weren't even shown to a table. It was a case of 'figure it out yourself'. Because we wanted to experience something Berlin-like anyway, and were hungry, we decided to stay. The food was tasty and the portions were nice. The service became a bit friendlier towards the end, but it felt fake and I didn't really feel welcome (the restaurant had almost no customers). Once we received the bill, it was clearly indicated with a pen that the tip had not been included; no tip from me, mind you. Normally I rarely write reviews, but it should be known.

Pro:
Beautiful location, nice portions, and tasty
Contra:
Bad service and then no shame in asking for a tip

text:
Spanish flair right in the heart of Alexanderplatz 🇪🇸🍷

On August 3rd, the three of us visited El Colmado at Alexanderplatz in the afternoon and had a truly wonderful time. We loved the atmosphere... relaxed, cozy, and with a lovely Spanish flair right in the middle of Berlin.

The sangria was excellent, fruity, perfectly chilled, and simply perfect for a relaxing afternoon. 🍷😍

The tapas are also an absolute must for us! We were particularly impressed by the octopus and the chorizo ​​platter... both were incredibly delicious and completely won us over.

We thoroughly enjoyed our afternoon there and would definitely come back. Anyone looking for Spanish food and a touch of vacation right in the middle of Berlin should definitely stop by.

Highly recommended! 🇪🇸❤️
originalText:
Spanisches Flair mitten am Alexanderplatz 🇪🇸🍷

Wir waren am 03.08. am Nachmittag zu dritt im El Colmado am Alexanderplatz und hatten eine wirklich schöne Zeit. Schon die Atmosphäre hat uns sehr gut gefallen.... entspannt, gemütlich und mit einem schönen spanischen Flair mitten in Berlin.

Die Sangria war hervorragend, fruchtig, gut gekühlt und einfach perfekt für einen entspannten Nachmittag. 🍷😍

Auch die Tapas sind für uns ein absolutes Muss! Besonders begeistert waren wir vom Pulpo und von der Chorizo-Platte... beides war richtig lecker und hat uns geschmacklich überzeugt.

Wir haben den Nachmittag dort sehr genossen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Wer spanisches Essen und ein bisschen Urlaubsgefühl mitten in Berlin sucht, sollte hier unbedingt vorbeischauen.
Klare Empfehlung! 🇪🇸❤️

The food? Absolutely fantastic. Everything was delicious, very well prepared, and the star dish was the patatas bravas, which are every bit as good as any bar in Madrid. I also ordered the tortilla, which was excellent, and the tomato with anchovies.
For dessert, the cheesecake, whose texture was, in my opinion, perfect, although a little too soft.
The staff speaks perfect Spanish, and the restaurant's decor is exactly what you'd expect, transporting you straight to a Spanish bar. Highly recommended, and if I ever return to Berlin, I'll definitely eat here again.

text:
An absolute disaster!

Even though the place was practically empty (a maximum of five tables on the patio), we waited almost 10 minutes for the menus. The first thing we were told after sitting down was, "Tip is not included." Apparently, they assumed we were tourists and didn't understand German.

The waiter, who was also the bartender, was mostly occupied with phone calls in Turkish and barely acknowledged us. He was also constantly engaged in loud conversations with a young blonde woman. Whether it was a relationship drama, a family matter, or something else entirely, I obviously can't say. The fact is, however, that the conversation was so loud that we could barely hear ourselves talk at our table.

After our order was finally taken, they even forgot one of our burgers.

The cocktails are an absolute rip-off. The prices are completely unreasonable. For that kind of money, you can easily get three times the quality and quantity in Miami or Hollywood.

What's particularly strange is that we'd already tried the kebab shop right next door a few days earlier, which was also a disaster. We later found out that the two places belong to the same company. Had we known that beforehand, we wouldn't have gone there in the first place.

The worst part came with the bill: it was simply scribbled on a piece of paper. That's bordering on unprofessional behavior. They claimed the card payment wasn't working at first. However, when I mentioned that I needed a proper receipt because I was going to claim the bill on my taxes, everything suddenly worked again. Draw your own conclusions.

In short: there are countless better restaurants and bars around Alexanderplatz. Save yourself time, money, and frustration. To me, the whole place seemed primarily focused on one thing: being extremely eager for tips.

ownerResponseText:
Dear Tibbie,

thank you for sharing your feedback. We would like to clarify the situation regarding our dress code policy.

At Bellboy, we have an elegant style attire that is part of the overall atmosphere and experience we aim to create. When making a reservation, our guests receive information clearly stating that very casual clothing, including flip flops and overly casual styles, is not accepted.

In your case, we had already made an exception and welcomed you despite the footwear, as we wanted you to enjoy the Bellboy experience. However, when your boyfriend arrived wearing a combination of a T-shirt, shorts,  neck flap cap and Birkenstocks, it unfortunately went beyond what we are able to accommodate according to our dress code guidelines, which are clearly communicated on our website.

To find a solution, we offered you the option of being seated in our Concierge Room, where we are more flexible with the dress code, and you accepted this alternative. As a gesture of goodwill for the change of seating, we also offered complimentary shots, which you accepted.

We always aim to handle these situations respectfully and find a solution for our guests while maintaining the atmosphere of Bellboy. We are therefore disappointed to read a review that does not reflect the efforts made by our team to accommodate you.

We would be happy to discuss this further with you directly on hostlead@bellboyberlin.com and hope that after understanding the full context of the situation, you may reconsider your review.

Best regards,
Bellboy Team

text:
We have been living in Berlin since 2019 and have been regular guests at Bellboy ever since. We also frequently recommend Bellboy (and Butler) to friends, many of whom make it a point to visit whenever they are in Berlin. We keep coming back because of the consistently excellent service, outstanding cocktails, and the unique, whimsical atmosphere.

Unfortunately, our experience yesterday was very different.

The hostess at the entrance (whom we had not seen before) told my husband and me that we were not dressed appropriately. We were both dressed in neat, smart-casual attire. I was wearing a collared long-sleeve top, dark Diesel jeans, Louis Vuitton sneakers, a Longines watch, and carrying a Dior bag. My husband was wearing a clean T-shirt, Diesel jeans, Jack Wolfskin shoes, and a Tissot watch. Neither of us was wearing ripped, distressed, or otherwise inappropriate clothing.

She then asked whether we could go back home and change before returning. I was genuinely taken aback and politely pointed to my Dior bag, saying that I didn’t understand why we were being asked to change. It simply didn’t make sense to me that our attire would be considered unsuitable. After a brief exchange, she eventually made an “exception” and allowed us inside.

Once seated, everything was exactly as we have come to expect from Bellboy. Our server was wonderful, the cocktails were excellent, and the rest of the evening was fantastic.

However, first impressions matter. Being greeted in such a dismissive manner left us feeling embarrassed and unwelcome before our evening had even begun. As loyal customers who have enthusiastically recommended Bellboy to countless friends over the years, this was particularly disappointing. The warmth and hospitality that Bellboy is known for should begin at the door, not only once guests are seated.

We genuinely enjoy Bellboy and hope this feedback is taken in the constructive spirit in which it is intended. We’d love for future visits to reflect the welcoming experience that has made us regulars for so many years.
ownerResponseText:
Dear Rimi,

thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly understand your frustration and are sorry that your arrival left you feeling disappointed.

At Bellboy, we have an elegant style dress code in place to maintain the atmosphere our guests expect. During your visit, you were wearing a jersey-style top, and your husband was wearing a T-shirt, which unfortunately does not fall within the dress code we ask our guests to follow.

That said, when you mentioned that you have been loyal guests of Bellboy for many years, we were happy to make an exception and welcome you inside. This is not something we normally do, but we genuinely appreciated your continued support.

We truly value your loyalty and appreciate you bringing your experience to our attention.

We would love the opportunity to discuss this with you personally. If you are willing, please send us an email at hostlead@bellboyberlin.com, and we would be happy to arrange a small gesture from us to you on your next visit as a token of our appreciation and to ensure your next experience begins on the right note.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to Bellboy again soon.

text:
If you happen to be from Southeast Asia, especially Singapore, Malaysia, or Indonesia, and are missing familiar food, you’ll probably love Mamakan. They have many of the classics you might be craving, from teh tarik and kaya toast with butter to Hainanese chicken rice and nasi lemak.

I’ve been to Mamakan twice now, and my favorites so far are definitely the teh tarik, tofu, Hainanese chicken rice, and kaya toast. The chicken is also halal, as indicated on their menu, which is a big plus. On my last visit, I also tried the satay ayam and bought a jar of kaya to take home. The tofu was especially good.

I’ve been wanting to try their laksa, so hopefully that will be next!

What I also like about Mamakan is that you can tell when people genuinely put love and care into what they do, and you can definitely feel that here. The food is comforting and familiar, especially when you’ve been away from Southeast Asia for a while.

Definitely a place I’d recommend and happily come back to.

text:
We are local and have been wanting to try this place for awhile. We wanted so much to love it and, sadly, just didn't. Service was a struggle. We were seated and after 10 minutes had to go in and ask for a server because no one had come by. Mind you, there was 1 other table on the patio and their server walked right by us several times. Even after going in and asking, we waited another 5 minutes for a server. The hostess saw us still waiting while seating another table and said "I'm so sorry, the server that had your table gave it to someone else." The table she was seating while saying this to us had the same experience. And we heard them ask for a server too. Our server was friendly enough but once she brought our food she never came back to fill water, ask if we needed anything, etc...

The food had good flavor but needs tweaks. I ordered the steak flatbread and it was an oily mess and several of the steak pieces were tough. It was a pile of food that was overall a mess and hard to eat. My husband had the steak tacos and felt they were only ok. My kid DID love her kids burger and fries.

They are not capitalizing on the fact they are a distillery. They should showcase that and their specialty drinks. That's a lost opportunity.

Overall, I don't think we will be back. They need to clean up Service first and foremost, but the food isn't great for the price.

First of all: I'm describing my personal experience.

The initial impression was positive. We went into the shop, and my wife went to the restroom first.

I was greeted promptly and told that we could choose a table outside in the back and would then be served by him or a colleague, depending on the section.

While I waited for my wife, I browsed the beer selection. It was quite well-presented, so we sat down at a table with anticipation.

However, our anticipation quickly faded. The waitress walked past us several times—no greeting, no menu, no service.

Even after making eye contact several times and trying to call out, we left disappointed after 20 minutes.

It's a shame; it seems like a good place with good beer, but the service was lacking.

Zunächst vorab: Ich schildere meine persönliche Erfahrung.

text: We visited the restaurant on Saturday, June 6, 2026. Upon arrival, the atmosphere was pleasant. However, we made a reservation based on a menu that wasn't available. It was a different one. We informed the waitress, who kindly explained that they hadn't updated it yet. We ordered items from the new menu, but they didn't have certain dishes available either. The menu was very small, and we were surprised that they weren't prepared for it either. I'm Peruvian and I often visit Peruvian restaurants in different European cities, and I must say that, however much of a fusion cuisine it is, what we ordered fell short. The chicha morada didn't even have the color of chicha, which was the bare minimum to start with. The picarones for dessert were two small balls that looked more like profiteroles, completely missing the essence of the typical picarón. The ají de gallina was okay, but nothing out of the ordinary, and there were some "tacos" that you could get elsewhere, not necessarily at a Peruvian restaurant. I deeply regret paying so much for a meal that was "somewhat more gourmet" but lacked the explosion of flavors that Peruvians are accustomed to. For someone unfamiliar with Peruvian cuisine, it might be somewhat authentic, but for someone who knows Peruvian food and takes diners to try "Peruvian fusion," I wouldn't recommend it. The photos of the "picarones," "chicha," and salmon "tiradito" are not good.

placeAddress: Mumbai Local - Indian Food, Rathausstraße 13, 10178 Berlin, Germany
text:
There were four of us at Mumbai Local. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a lovely terrace with a comfortable seating area.

Unfortunately, the service leaves much to be desired.

When we asked for a table for four, we were told we could choose our own. In the end, we had to push two tables together ourselves. We finally received the menus after about 10 minutes.

We ordered four different dishes and explicitly stated twice that we wanted them all to be spicy. Despite this, all the dishes were geared more towards European tastes and weren't spicy at all.

Furthermore, we were initially only given two sets of cutlery for four people.

The food arrived after about 25 minutes. While the food was generally good, we felt it would have tasted even better with the desired level of spiciness.

During the meal, no one checked on us to see if everything was alright. For example, one of our colleagues wanted some extra salt and tried to get the staff's attention, but unfortunately, no one came to our attention.



We were served the food. In conclusion: The food was good, but the service definitely needs improvement. The restaurant is beautiful, and the terrace is a particular highlight. With more attentive service and better consideration of guests' needs, the overall experience could be significantly enhanced.
originalText:
Wir waren zu viert bei Mumbai Local. Das Restaurant ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hat eine wunderschöne Terrasse mit einem angenehmen Sitzbereich.

Leider gibt es beim Service noch einiges zu verbessern.

Als wir nach einem Platz für vier Personen gefragt haben, wurde uns gesagt, dass wir uns selbst einen Platz aussuchen können. Am Ende mussten wir selbst zwei Tische zusammenschieben. Nach ungefähr 10 Minuten bekamen wir dann die Speisekarten.

Wir haben vier verschiedene Gerichte bestellt und zweimal ausdrücklich gesagt, dass alle Gerichte scharf sein sollen. Trotzdem waren alle Gerichte eher auf den europäischen Geschmack abgestimmt und überhaupt nicht scharf.

Außerdem bekamen wir zunächst nur zwei Bestecksets für vier Personen.

Nach ungefähr 25 Minuten kam das Essen. Geschmacklich war es grundsätzlich gut, aber mit der gewünschten Schärfe hätte es unserer Meinung nach noch besser geschmeckt.

Während des Essens wurde leider überhaupt nicht nachgefragt, ob alles in Ordnung ist. Einer unserer Kollegen wollte zum Beispiel etwas zusätzliches Salz und hat versucht, die Aufmerksamkeit des Personals zu bekommen. Leider kam niemand zu uns.

Fazit: Das Essen war gut, aber der Service muss definitiv verbessert werden. Das Restaurant ist wunderschön und besonders die Terrasse ist ein großer Pluspunkt. Mit einem aufmerksameren Service und besserer Berücksichtigung der Wünsche der Gäste könnte das Gesamterlebnis deutlich besser sein.

placeAddress: Larb Koi, Krossener Str. 15, 10245 Berlin, Germany
text:
Been meaning to visit Larb Koi after enthusiastic reviews from my friends.
Upon arriving, the waitress asked if we were there before and mentioned that there are no vegan options in the menu (we were aware that even meatless dishes contain fish sauce) and that the food is properly spicy (and it was!). Good to be upfront about that! Unfortunately, another info that is visible right at the door is that the restaurant is cash only. In 2026, restaurant at this level not accepting cards is a bad experience, even for Berlin standards. We took out the cash and proceeded anyway.

We ordered oysters - they were big and juicy, I really liked them. We weren’t extremely hungry, so we shared a papaya salad (really spicy!) and tataki tuna with lemongrass salad. The waitress recommended to order 2-3 plates for 2 people to share, however, two would definitely not be enough for us if we were hungrier. The food was really good though, fresh and of taste.

Together with drinks (water, one beer and one glass of wine) we paid about 60 euros (without the tip), which is really a lot considering the size of the portions. This matched the experience of my friends who also said Larb Koi wasn’t cheap.

All in all, amazing food but quite expensive for the amount you’re getting. If the portions were bigger and the cards were accepted, it would be a 5 stars review, unfortunately those two things slightly spoiled an otherwise nice evening.
