placeAddress: Larb Koi, Krossener Str. 15, 10245 Berlin, Germany
text:
Larb Koi is one of my favorite restaurants in Berlin, but what I love most is that it never seems to be just me. I honestly can’t remember how many friends I’ve brought here over the years, and every single time the reaction is the same: people leave impressed and asking when we’re coming back.

The food is outstanding. Every dish is packed with flavor, beautifully balanced, and consistently excellent. Whether someone is already familiar with Thai food or trying it for the first time, Larb Koi always seems to win them over.

What makes this place truly special, though, is the hospitality. The warmth, kindness, and professionalism of the entire team are exceptional. Even when the restaurant is completely full and buzzing, everyone remains welcoming, attentive, and genuinely pleasant. You never feel rushed; you feel looked after.

That’s what keeps me coming back. Great food brings people in, but the combination of incredible food and remarkable hospitality is what makes Larb Koi stand out. It is always a joy to visit, and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

text:
My wife and I go out quite often. We prefer to sit at the bar if available due to faster service and like to engage in conversation with our servers. When we arrived it wasn't busy. We ordered our food and it took a very long time for a burger and a BLT. When the food finally came out of the kitchen the server walked past us and wandered around  trying to figure out where we were...Right in front of you! We waved her over. Food was very good. No one came back to check on us to see if we wanted anything else. By this time there was a growing number of what I suspect were regulars. They had the full attention of the staff. One of the workers whom I believe was the manager was in and out of the kitchen and sometimes behind the bar with a beer in her hand. We had to wave them down for the bill. Still entertaining the regulars ,we sat waiting to pay by card. 10 -15 minutes later we left cash and left. My order was prepared incorrectly and was given a 10% discount.
We may go back in the nice weather. They seem to have a nice patio. All in all. Atmosphere was nice, food was great, but the service was absolutely horrible. The guys that sat next to me were actually slamming their hands on the counter to get attention to be served.

We were very disappointed by the way we were treated.

There were several empty tables on the terrace, and because we were three people and the tables are extremely small, we simply moved two tables together. The waitress immediately told us that this was not allowed.

What made the situation even more frustrating was that the table right next to us already had four people sitting at two joined tables, while another table designed for six people was occupied by only three guests. It was impossible not to notice that the rule seemed to be applied selectively.

The waitress was rude, unfriendly, and made us feel as though tourists were not welcome. Good service is not only about serving food, but also about treating customers with respect and common sense.

placeName: OLAM African and Intercontinental Restaurant Berlin
placeAddress: OLAM African and Intercontinental Restaurant Berlin, Reinickendorfer Str. 102, 13347 Berlin, Germany
text:
As a Nigerian living away from home, finding food that genuinely tastes like home is something special — and this restaurant really delivered.

I ordered a variety of dishes for my family, and honestly, the food took me straight back to my childhood in Nigeria. The flavours, the spices, the way everything was prepared… it brought back memories of eating good homemade food back home. Every dish had that familiar taste and comfort that is sometimes difficult to find when you’re far away from home.

My family absolutely loved the food too, and I was especially happy to see everyone enjoying the different dishes. Everything was full of flavour, well seasoned, and tasted authentic without being overwhelming.

To make the experience even better, I found out that the owner is from the same state in Nigeria as me. We had a really nice chat, and it was such a great feeling to meet someone from the same part of Nigeria and connect over our shared background. That personal connection made the whole experience even more special.

This is more than just a restaurant for me — it’s a little taste of home. 🇳🇬❤️

Thank you for bringing such authentic Nigerian flavours here. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend it to anyone missing the taste of home or simply looking for really good Nigerian food.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

placeName: OLAM African and Intercontinental Restaurant Berlin
placeAddress: OLAM African and Intercontinental Restaurant Berlin, Reinickendorfer Str. 102, 13347 Berlin, Germany

5 stars without a doubt! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

text: Warning! They can only serve you “room temperature” draft beer! Finding this Vietnamese restaurant in 36-degree heat, and with only a small fan and no air conditioning, I ordered a draft beer to cool down. As soon as the beer arrived, I had a bad feeling; there wasn't a single wisp of condensation around the rim of the glass. Sure enough, after taking a sip, I confirmed it was room temperature draft beer. I was completely dumbfounded. Later, when the waiter brought the food, I asked him why the beer wasn't iced. The male waiter pretended not to understand English, saying "cold, cold." I directly told him it wasn't cold at all. I showed the beer to a male customer at the next table, who also immediately said the draft beer wasn't cold at all, and that beer should be served iced. Eventually, the male waiter couldn't resist and called the owner's wife over. She still pretended not to understand or speak English, and the customers at the next table again chimed in, saying beer should be served iced. The owner's wife, seemingly unable to resist the support of the customers at the next table, actually suggested adding ice? I was totally dumbfounded. Who adds ice to draft beer? I refused immediately and told the male waiter I wanted a refund for my draft beer. After finishing a plate of indescribably bad stir-fried udon noodles, I went to the counter to pay, but the male waiter added the cost of the draft beer to the bill. I immediately said I wouldn't pay for it, and the waiter had no choice but to silently deduct the cost and then settle the bill. Overall, the experience was truly awful. I advise everyone to avoid this place to avoid being sweltering in the heat, getting terrible food, and then being incredibly angry.

text:
Great concept, but unfortunately with weaknesses in execution.

I went to Knutschfleck Berlin for brunch with my best friend – as a belated birthday present. The concept and the location are truly unique and something very special. We also really liked the staff's costumes and the overall style – right down to the restrooms. All the staff were consistently friendly and attentive.

Unfortunately, there were a few things that marred our visit.

Even the entrance was difficult to find. A sign at the stairs to Knutschfleck would be very helpful, as we ended up walking around the TV tower twice.

The seating arrangement was particularly unpleasant. The tables were extremely close together, so you automatically overheard the conversations of the neighboring tables. Getting to the buffet was also very awkward. There was an empty table right next to us, which we weren't allowed to use despite asking several times, supposedly because more guests were arriving. We were there from 10:00 am to 12:30 pm, and no one came to that table. Since it wasn't particularly crowded overall, we couldn't understand why.

There was a technical problem at the beginning, which thankfully was resolved very quickly. That wasn't a problem for us at all – these things happen. However, the waitress kept apologizing for it afterward, which became quite annoying after a while. One apology would have been perfectly sufficient.

The buffet was rather small for our taste, and the selection was limited. Especially since the restaurant advertises that there's "something for everyone," we had expected more. Unfortunately, there was practically nothing for people with lactose intolerance or for vegans. Even at full capacity, I can imagine there would be longer waiting times at the buffet. For the price, the buffet was rather disappointing overall.

The drinks, on the other hand, were excellent, and the show was okay overall – we really enjoyed some parts, while others simply weren't to our taste.

Overall, we were rather disappointed and probably wouldn't come again. **The concept is truly a fabulous idea and a great attraction for Berlin – however, in our opinion, there's still room for improvement in the execution.**

Despite our criticism, we extend our sincere thanks to all the staff, who were friendly and welcoming from the moment we entered until our departure.
originalText:
Tolles Konzept, aber leider mit Schwächen in der Umsetzung

Ich war mit meiner besten Freundin zum Brunch im Knutschfleck Berlin – als nachträgliches Geburtstagsgeschenk. Das Konzept und die Location sind wirklich außergewöhnlich und etwas ganz Besonderes. Auch die Kostüme der Mitarbeiter und der gesamte Stil – bis hin zur Toilette – haben uns sehr gefallen. Das gesamte Personal war durchweg freundlich und aufmerksam.

Leider gab es aber einige Punkte, die unseren Besuch getrübt haben.

Schon der Eingang war schwer zu finden. Ein Schild an der Treppe zum Knutschfleck wäre hier sehr hilfreich, denn wir sind zweimal um den Fernsehturm gelaufen.

Besonders unangenehm war die Sitzsituation. Die Tische standen extrem eng beieinander, sodass man automatisch die Gespräche der Nachbartische mitbekam. Auch der Weg zum Buffet war dadurch sehr umständlich. Direkt neben uns war ein freier Tisch, den wir trotz mehrfacher Nachfrage nicht nutzen durften, da angeblich noch Gäste kommen würden. Wir waren von 10:00 bis 12:30 Uhr dort und niemand kam an diesen Tisch. Da es insgesamt auch nicht besonders voll war, war das für uns leider nicht nachvollziehbar.

Zu Beginn gab es ein technisches Problem, das zum Glück innerhalb kürzester Zeit behoben wurde. Das war für uns auch überhaupt kein Problem – so etwas kann passieren. Allerdings entschuldigte sich die Kellnerin danach immer wieder dafür, was nach einiger Zeit einfach nur noch unangenehm wurde. Eine Entschuldigung wäre völlig ausreichend gewesen.

Das Buffet war für unseren Geschmack ziemlich klein und die Auswahl begrenzt. Gerade weil damit geworben wird, dass „für jeden etwas dabei“ sei, hatten wir hier mehr erwartet. Für Menschen mit Laktoseintoleranz oder für Veganer war leider so gut wie nichts dabei. Auch bei voller Auslastung könnte ich mir längere Wartezeiten am Buffet vorstellen. Für den Preis war das Buffet für uns insgesamt eher enttäuschend.

Die Getränke waren hingegen top und die Show war insgesamt okay – einiges hat uns wirklich gut gefallen, anderes war einfach nicht unser Geschmack.

Insgesamt waren wir leider eher enttäuscht und würden wahrscheinlich nicht noch einmal kommen. **Das Konzept ist wirklich eine fabelhafte Idee und eine tolle Attraktion für Berlin – an der Umsetzung gibt es unserer Meinung nach aber noch einiges zu verbessern.**

Trotz unserer Kritik ein großes Lob an das gesamte Personal, das uns vom Einlass bis zur Verabschiedung freundlich begegnet ist.

text:
Months in advance, I had purchased tickets for 12 people (not all at once) to celebrate my 30th birthday at Knutschfleck. I had also contacted them several times by email, explicitly stating that I would be celebrating my birthday there, bringing a cake, and would like a seat (by the phone) from which we could see the show well.

Only the evening before my birthday, at 10:32 p.m., was I informed that the ventilation system at Knutschfleck had broken down and that we had therefore been reserved at its sister venue, Wilde Matilde. Since I was also told that the artists would be performing there, I was understanding and initially pleased with the alternative.

However, once there, it turned out that we were given three separate tables, some of which barely had a view of the show. My friends and I ended up having to push the tables together ourselves. Apparently, the information that I was celebrating my birthday and bringing a cake hadn't been passed on.

What was particularly disappointing was that it was also extremely hot in Wilde Matilde. I had to go outside about every hour because it was more pleasant outside than in the restaurant. As a result, I unfortunately couldn't properly enjoy my own birthday or the show.

Since the artists from Knutschfleck were also performing at Wilde Matilde, and some of them were artists I already knew from Knutschfleck, I got the impression afterward that the two events might have been combined. Of course, I can't say for sure if that was actually the case. That's precisely why I would have appreciated more transparent communication.

I come from the restaurant industry myself and completely understand that technical problems can occur. But that's also why I know how important good communication and preparation are.

In the end, there were 11 of us, and we spent about €70 per person there that evening, including our expenses. For that price, the overall experience was definitely not worth it, and in retrospect, it wasn't worth the money.

After months of planning, tickets for 12 people, and multiple prior communications, I would have expected significantly more organization and appreciation for my birthday.

It's a real shame, because I was really looking forward to this evening at Knutschfleck.
originalText:
Ich hatte bereits Monate im Voraus Tickets für 12 Perosnen (nicht alle auf einmal) gekauft, um meinen 30. Geburtstag im Knutschfleck zu feiern. Zusätzlich hatte ich mehrfach per E-Mail Kontakt aufgenommen und ausdrücklich mitgeteilt, dass ich meinen Geburtstag dort feiere, eine Torte mitbringe und gerne einen Platz (am Telefon) hätte, von dem aus wir die Show gut sehen können.

Erst am Abend vor meinem Geburtstag um 22:32 Uhr wurde mir mitgeteilt, dass die Lüftungsanlage im Knutschfleck ausgefallen sei und für uns deshalb im Schwesterlokal Wilde Matilde reserviert wurde. Da mir gleichzeitig gesagt wurde, dass auch die Künstler dort auftreten würden, habe ich verständnisvoll reagiert und mich zunächst über die Alternative gefreut.

Vor Ort stellte sich allerdings heraus, dass wir drei voneinander getrennte Tische bekamen und teilweise kaum Sicht auf die Show hatten. Meine Freunde und ich mussten die Tische schließlich selbst zusammenschieben. Auch die Information, dass ich meinen Geburtstag feiere und eine Torte mitbringe, war offenbar nicht weitergegeben worden.

Besonders enttäuschend war, dass es in der Wilde Matilde ebenfalls extrem heiß war. Ich musste ungefähr jede Stunde nach draußen gehen, weil es draußen angenehmer war als im Restaurant. Dadurch konnte ich meinen eigenen Geburtstag und die Show leider nicht richtig genießen.

Da zudem die Künstler des Knutschflecks in der Wilde Matilde auftraten und darunter Künstler waren, die ich bereits aus dem Knutschfleck kannte, entstand bei mir im Nachhinein der Eindruck, dass möglicherweise beide Veranstaltungen zusammengelegt wurden. Ob das tatsächlich so war, kann ich natürlich nicht beurteilen. Gerade deshalb hätte ich mir eine transparentere Kommunikation gewünscht.

Ich komme selbst aus der Gastronomie und habe absolut Verständnis dafür, dass technische Probleme auftreten können. Aber gerade deshalb weiß ich auch, wie wichtig eine gute Kommunikation und Vorbereitung sind.

Wir waren letztendlich 11 Personen und haben inklusive unserer Ausgaben an diesem Abend ungefähr 70 € pro Person dort gelassen. Für dieses Geld war das Gesamterlebnis für mich leider definitiv nicht angemessen und rückblickend auch nicht das Geld wert.

Nach monatelanger Planung, Tickets für 12 Personen und mehrfacher vorheriger Kommunikation hätte ich mir für meinen Geburtstag deutlich mehr Organisation und Wertschätzung gewünscht.

Sehr schade, denn ich hatte mich wirklich auf diesen Abend im Knutschfleck gefreut.

text: Before heading to the concert, we wanted to grab a bite to eat here. There are plenty of tables both inside and out, so reservations are probably only recommended for larger groups. The somewhat scuffed menu offers German, meat-heavy dishes ranging from currywurst and roast pork to Weisswurst. Anyone who rarely eats in restaurants, or is only familiar with canteens or all-inclusive resorts, will likely find themselves right at home here – it tastes like home. The quick and friendly service makes up for a lot, and of course, it's not easy to feed so many guests. 29 euros for a dry salad from a plastic bag with four equally dried-out cucumber slices, one (!) halved cherry tomato that clearly hadn't seen the sun, even in August, tiny chanterelle mushrooms, and four just-about-decent strips of steak? Even the apple cider vinegar poured in the middle couldn't save it. My companion's Wiener Schnitzel arrived in two (pre-made?) roughly equal-sized, palm-sized pieces with plenty of breading, a quarter of a lemon, and a dollop of potato and cucumber salad. Why the salad came with a jar of solid (refrigerated?) cranberry jelly, which I could only eat sliced, was beyond me. The two older ladies at the next table did it right and shared a tarte flambée. Fewer dishes with better quality ingredients would have been preferable. It didn't spoil our evening, though, thanks to the friendly service.
originalText: Vor dem Konzertbesuch wollten wir uns hier noch stärken. Sowie innen als auch außen gibt es viele Tische, sodass eine Reservierung wohl nur für größere Gruppen empfohlen wird. Die angegrabbelte Speisekarte bietet deutsche, fleischlastige Gerichte auf einer Reise von Currywurst über Schweinebraten bis zur Weisswurscht und wer selten in Restaurants isst oder nur Kantine oder All-inclusive kennt, findet sich hier wahrscheinlich wieder und da schmeckts nach Heimat. Der schnelle und freundliche Service macht einiges wett und natürlich ist es nicht einfach, so viele Gäste mit Essen zu versorgen. 29 Euro für den trockenen Salat aus dem Folienbeutel mit vier ebenso eingetrockneten Gurkenscheiben, einer (!) gehälfteten Kirschtomate, die selbst im August noch nie die Sonne gesehen hat sowie winzige Pfifferlinge und vier ganz ok schmeckende Steakstreifen? Da hilft auch der in die Mitte gegossene Apfelessig nicht. Das Wiener Schnitzel meiner Begleitung kam in zwei (vorgefertigten?) etwa gleichgrossen handtellergroßen Stücken mit reichlich Panade, einem Viertel Zitrone und einem Klacks Karoffelgurkensalat. Warum es zum Salat ein Glas festes (Kühlschrank?) Preiselbeergelee gab, das ich nur in Scheiben hätte dazu essen können, hat sich mir nicht erschlossen. Die zwei älteren Damen am Nachbartisch haben es richtig gemacht und sich einen Flammkuchen geteilt. Schöner wären weniger Gerichte und dafür bessere Qualität der Zutaten. Den Abend hat’s uns trotzdem nicht verdorben, dem netten Service sei Dank.

text:
We ate at Kourosh for the first time today, July 28, 2026, and we were absolutely thrilled! 🤗
The ambiance is beautiful and stylish, and at 5:30 pm the sun bathes the restaurant in a particularly lovely light!

The service – was it the owner? – was extremely friendly and attentive. The four of us enjoyed a potpourri of Persian cuisine, which was specially prepared for us. The variety of appetizers, kebab dishes, and ghemey were all delicious!!! 👌 A big compliment to the kitchen staff! We were especially surprised by the vanilla ice cream with saffron and kirsch, combined with glass noodle ice cream! Absolutely delicious! The prices are also very reasonable. This restaurant is definitely worth a return visit; we felt very comfortable! Thank you for your hospitality; we will be back and will definitely recommend you! 😍❤️🥂

text:
We went there for lunch.

There were no other guests – the place was completely empty. The server was friendly and showed us to a table.

We were given the menus. When I saw the prices of the appetizers, I had to think for a moment about why they were so expensive. I thought maybe the portions were particularly large or something. 😂😂😂

I mean, we have so many Persian restaurants in Berlin, and yet the prices are really unusual.

Then I thought, "Come on, let's order in. Maybe the quality will be better."

We ordered two appetizers and two main courses.

The appetizers, however, were of just average quality, and the portions were rather small. 😂🥲

The main courses were okay, but also just standard quality.

The house beer, by the way, was a wheat beer that they simply called saffron beer. 😂😂😂

After our visit, I finally understood why the place was empty at lunchtime.

Total bill:

* 2 drinks
* 2 appetizers
* 2 main courses

€110 🙂

Ich meine, wir haben in Berlin so viele persische Restaurants, und dafür sind die Preise wirklich nicht normal.

text:
Is Jasper's always worth a visit? Unfortunately, my experience on a Saturday didn't.

Around 5:30 p.m., on a beautiful day, I spontaneously decided to grab a bite to eat and politely asked if I could use one of the many free tables outside. Of about 15 tables outside, only one was occupied. Despite this, I was told that there was no more room outside because "all the guests are arriving soon" and the tables were reserved. I could only sit inside.

I accepted this and went to eat elsewhere instead. When I returned almost an hour later, there were only three or four tables occupied outside.

Of course, a restaurant can accept reservations and plan its seating accordingly. However, as a solo diner, you don't feel very welcome when you're turned away despite the nearly empty terrace, and the advertised occupancy is subsequently nowhere near what was expected.
originalText:
Das Jasper's ist jederzeit einen Besuch wert? Meine Erfahrung an einem Samstag leider nicht.

Bei schönstem Wetter gegen 17:30 Uhr wollte ich spontan etwas essen und fragte höflich, ob ich alleine einen der zahlreichen freien Tische im Außenbereich nutzen könne. Von etwa 15 Außentischen war gerade einmal einer besetzt. Trotzdem wurde mir mitgeteilt, dass draußen nichts mehr möglich sei, da „gleich alle Gäste kommen“ und die Tische reserviert seien. Ich könne nur drinnen sitzen.

Das habe ich akzeptiert und bin stattdessen woanders essen gegangen. Als ich knapp eine Stunde später erneut vorbeikam, waren im Außenbereich gerade einmal drei bis vier Tische besetzt.

Natürlich kann ein Restaurant Reservierungen annehmen und seine Tische entsprechend planen. Als einzelner Gast fühlt man sich jedoch wenig willkommen, wenn man trotz nahezu leerer Terrasse abgewiesen wird und sich die angekündigte Auslastung anschließend nicht annähernd bestätigt.

text:
The restaurant used to be excellent! Unfortunately, the quality has declined significantly. The fried chicken, a classic, has now been replaced by schnitzel... Desserts like ice cream are extremely small portions for outrageous prices.

The service staff has almost completely changed and is unfortunately very unfriendly. The understaffing is clearly noticeable; for an extended period (an hour), the table was completely ignored. When paying, even after leaving a tip, the change was simply thrown onto the table without a word.

Exception: The best waiter in Berlin works here (he's the only visible constant at Jasper). He's in a great mood, drinks Sambuca with the customers, and is simply in good spirits.

Das Restaurant war in der Vergangenheit exzellent!  Leider hat die Qualität deutlich abgenommen, das Backhänchen war ein Klassiker und ist jetzt zum Schnitzel mutiert... Nachtisch wie Eis sind extrem kleine Portion für unverschämte Preise.
Die Bedienung ist fast komplett ausgewechselt und leider sehr unfreundlich. Die Unterbesetzung ist deutlich spürbar, längere Zeit (eine Stunde) wird der Tisch vollständig ignoriert. Beim Bezahlen trotz Trinkgeld, wird das Rückgeld kommentarlos einfach auf den Tisch geworfen.
Ausnahme: Hier arbeitet der beste Kellner Berlins (dieser ist die einzige sichtbare Konstante bei Jasper), verbreitet sehr gute Laune, trinkt mit den Kunden Sambuca und ist einfach gut drauf.

text:
First, the good points. The staff was very friendly.

Now for the food. We had breakfast. We were told beforehand that it would take half an hour for breakfast to be served.

Unfortunately, the food was disappointing. Mushy pieces of kiwi, tasteless pineapple slices, and hard melon slices. The salmon was a shredded heap, not slices. Worst of all were the rock-hard rolls, which couldn't be cut with a knife. We could only break them and eat them in pieces. We complained about this, as I suspect several other guests had.

You have to like the crowded room and the closely packed tables. And the noise level.

I don't think we'll be visiting again.

placeAddress: Clandestino | Tapas & Wein, Waldemarstraße 29, 10999 Berlin-Bezirk Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Germany
text: The place is dirty and smells of fried food. The staff didn't know what wines they had. The food was mediocre and sloppy. The marinated anchovies seemed to have been served straight from the can—all stuck together, dry, and without even a drizzle of olive oil. The tuna meatballs were so dry they fell apart when touched with a fork, and the patatas bravas, baked instead of fried as they should be, were stale and soggy. But the worst part of the experience was when a man who seemed to be the owner came in, sat at the bar with his feet up, and, along with a child, started handling and cutting the ham and eating it directly without even washing their hands, right in front of all the customers. Seeing this, we asked for the bill and left. My wife and I, who have both worked in the food industry for over 20 years in Berlin and other cities in Europe and America, have never seen anything like it. A terrible oversight.
originalText: El lugar es sucio y huele a fritura el servicio no sabía de los vinos que tenían la comida es mediocre y descuidada los boquerones en vinagre los parecían servidos directamente del de la lata todos pegados entre sí  y secos y sin ni siquiera un poco de aceite de oliva para disimular, las albóndigas de atún estaban tan secas que se desmoronaban al tocarlas con el tenedor y papas bravas echas al horno en ves de fritas como deben ser estaban añejas y blandas. Pero lo peor de la experiencia fue cuando un señor que parecía el propietario entró al local, se sentó en la barra con los pies sobre la banca y junto con un niño empezaron a manipular y cortar el jamón y comiéndolo directamente sin ni siquiera lavarse las manos y frente a todos los clientes.  Al ver esto pedimos la cuenta y nos marchamos. Yo y mi mujer que ambos trabajamos en gastronomía desde más 20 años en Berlín y otras ciudades de Europa y América no hemos visto una cosa así nunca. Un terrible descuido.
ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your feedback. We regret that your experience was not to your liking.

We are surprised by your description of your visit. At our establishment, we take great care in the quality of our products and hygiene standards, something our regular customers are well aware of. Regarding the presence of a child: our bar is a place where families are welcome and children are welcome.

We also appreciate all comments and opinions. We will continue working to offer the best possible experience to our visitors.
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Gracias por su comentario. Lamentamos que su experiencia no haya sido de su agrado.

Nos sorprende la descripción que hace de su visita. En nuestro establecimiento cuidamos la calidad de los productos y las normas de higiene con mucha atención, algo que nuestros clientes habituales saben bien. Respecto a la presencia de un niño: nuestro bar es un lugar donde las familias son bienvenidas y los niños pueden estar.

Agradecemos igualmente todos los comentarios y opiniones. Seguiremos trabajando para ofrecer la mejor experiencia posible a quienes nos visitan.

text: Interesting to see previous reviews as we had the same experience: back in 2022 the food was just amazing! The change they apparently had really put a toll on the dishes. We had the olives, pan con tomate, baby squid, eggplant, artichokes and patatas bravas. We cannot recommend any of them and will unfortunately not come back. The food does not have much to do with Spanish food - we lived in Madrid some years. I hope the kitchen will improve and therefore give the following tips: pan con Tomate as tapas is served in Catalonia differently and not just crated tomato on baguette with a bit of salt. The artichokes were from the glass with a mustard sauce - did not taste, maybe tried the typical grilled artichoke hearts with olive oil and lemon. Also the eggplants were finely sliced, put in batter and fried. You can offer so much more with this great vegetable! This should not even be a dish how it was served. I hope the kitchen will become more authentic in the future. And on a side note: you’ll smell a lot after, not sure if the kitchen has a purifier or something. Also I missed a lot of good Spanish wines…Good luck!
ownerResponseText:
Hi S,
Sorry to hear you did not enjoy your time at Clan!
We don't strive for authentic Spanish cuisine, we just want our food to taste good. I'll be sure to share your recommendations with the kitchen staff.
Kind regards.

text: You wouldn't give it a second glance if you were just passing by, it looks so unassuming. But Shalimar was a very pleasant culinary experience for me. The subshi shorba tasted of vegetables, as did the subshi biryani, and not of MSG. Without exaggeration, it's the best Pakistani restaurant I've eaten at in my 14 years living in Berlin. I can't wait to try the other dishes. The place just has a charming feel: run by a hardworking family, simple yet fresh decor, friendly service, and one crucial quality: clean restrooms. See you soon!
originalText: Man würde beim Vorübergehen nicht zweimal hinschauen, so anspruchslos wie dieses Restaurant aussieht. Shalimar war für mich allerdings eine sehr angehme kulinarische Erfahrung. Die Subshi Shorba schmeckt nach Gemüse, so wie auch die Subshi Biryani, und nicht nach Geschmacksverstärker. Ohne Übertreibung das beste pakistanische Restaurant wo ich in den  14 Jahren meiner Berliner Aufenthalt gegessen habe. Ich kann es kaum erwarten, die anderen Gerichte auszuprobieren. Die Bude wirkt einfach sympatisch: von einer hart arbeitenden Familie betrieben, schlichte aber frisch-wirkende Einrichtung, freundliche Bedienung und eine äußerst entscheidende Eigentümlichkeit von Klasse: Saubere Toiletten.  Gerne bis bald!

text:

Next time I will come in person and introduce myself. I will order the same dishes again and I hope that you will show me the quality for which I have always appreciated you. Hello Team Kalaja,

Since your restaurant is one of my absolute favorites, it is important to me to give you honest feedback. I hope that you will continue to attach great importance to quality and freshness in the kitchen and service.

For my visit today (lunch):

* Espresso Macchiato: I left this one standing. The milk tasted sour and seemed to have been heated several times.

* Water and cola from the glass bottle: Are there no more glasses served? It seemed as if they should be drunk directly from the bottle.
* Mix-Grill: Die Cevapcici waren innen noch nicht durchgegart und es waren eedliche drei kleine Stücke. In addition, I had to express myself, no lamb meat to serve – but it was still on the teller. Das Essen haben wir daher stehen lassen.
* Goulash: Dieser wirkte leider nicht frisch. Auch dieses Gericht haben wir stehen lassen.
* Brot: Das Brot hatte nicht den Eindruck, vom selben Tag zu sein.

Das finde ich wirklich schade, weil ich euer Restaurant sehr schätze und bisher immer gerne bei euch gegessen habe.

Beim nächsen Besuch werde ich mich persönlich vorstellen. Ich werde dann dieselben Gerichte noch einmal bestellen und hoffe sehr, dass ihr mir zeigt, welche Qualität ich von euch gewohnt bin. Ich würde mich freuen, wenn mein heutiges Feedback als constructive Kritik verstanden wird, denn ich möchte auch in Zukunft gerne bei euch essen.
originalText:
Përshëndetje ekipi i Kalajas,

Meqenëse restoranti juaj është një nga të preferuarit e mi, e ndiej të rëndësishme t’ju jap një feedback të sinqertë. Do të doja që të vazhdoni t’i kushtoni rëndësi cilësisë, freskisë dhe shërbimit në kuzhinë dhe në restorant.

Për vizitën time të sotme (në drekë):

* Espresso Macchiato: E lashë pa e pirë, sepse qumështi kishte shije të thartë dhe dukej sikur ishte ngrohur disa herë.
* Uji dhe Coca-Cola në shishe qelqi: A nuk shërbehen më gotat? Dukej sikur duhej të pinim direkt nga shishja.
* Mix Grill: Qebapët nuk ishin pjekur mirë dhe ishin vetëm tre copë të vogla. Gjithashtu, kisha kërkuar që të mos kishte mish qengji, por prapëseprapë ishte në pjatë. Për këtë arsye e lamë ushqimin.
* Gullashi: Dukej sikur nuk ishte i freskët. Edhe këtë pjatë e lamë.
* Buka: Nuk dukej e freskët, sikur nuk ishte e ditës.

Më vjen shumë keq ta them këtë, sepse gjithmonë kam pasur një mendim shumë të mirë për restorantin tuaj.

Herën tjetër do të vij personalisht dhe do të prezantohem. Do të porosis përsëri të njëjtat pjata dhe shpresoj që të më tregoni cilësinë për të cilën ju kam vlerësuar gjithmonë. Shpresoj që këtë feedback ta merrni si kritikë konstruktive, sepse dëshira ime është të vazhdoj të jem klient i kënaqur i restorantit tuaj.

Hallo Team Kalaja,

da euer Restaurant zu meinen absoluten Favoriten gehört, ist es mir wichtig, euch ehrliches Feedback zu geben. Ich wünsche mir, dass ihr weiterhin großen Wert auf Qualität und Frische in Küche und Service legt.

Zu meinem heutigen Besuch (Mittag):

* Espresso Macchiato: Diesen habe ich stehen lassen. Die Milch hat sauer geschmeckt und wirkte mehrfach erhitzt.
* Wasser und Cola aus der Glasflasche: Werden keine Gläser mehr serviert? Es wirkte so, als sollte direkt aus der Flasche getrunken werden.
* Mix-Grill: Die Cevapcici waren innen noch nicht durchgegart und es waren lediglich drei kleine Stücke. Außerdem hatte ich ausdrücklich darum gebeten, kein Lammfleisch zu servieren – dennoch war es auf dem Teller. Das Essen haben wir daher stehen lassen.
* Gulasch: Dieser wirkte leider nicht frisch. Auch dieses Gericht haben wir stehen lassen.
* Brot: Das Brot hatte nicht den Eindruck, vom selben Tag zu sein.

Das finde ich wirklich schade, weil ich euer Restaurant sehr schätze und bisher immer gerne bei euch gegessen habe.

Beim nächsten Besuch werde ich mich persönlich vorstellen. Ich werde dann dieselben Gerichte noch einmal bestellen und hoffe sehr, dass ihr mir zeigt, welche Qualität ich von euch gewohnt bin. Ich würde mich freuen, wenn mein heutiges Feedback als konstruktive Kritik verstanden wird, denn ich möchte auch in Zukunft gerne bei euch essen.

text:
This review refers exclusively to the business lunch, i.e., the set lunch menu.

First, the positives: we used to go to the conservatory for lunch with colleagues once or twice a week during our lunch break. The lunch menu is always very varied and offers a choice between a meat dish and a vegetarian option. The vegetarian option is never a cheap alternative but usually a very tasty one. Kudos to the kitchen.

For the past few days, the price of the lunch menu has been increased by one euro – perfectly fine – but the option of an affordable "lunch drink" has been completely removed, so drinks now have to be purchased at the regular price. In my opinion, that's where the problem lies. Thanks to a 0.33l apple spritzer for €6.50, I now have almost €20 on the bill for my lunch. All in all, that's simply too much for just once or twice a week. The pricing no longer makes sense, which is a real shame. There are good, and more affordable, options in the neighborhood where you can get a decent lunch including a drink for €10-13. Most of my colleagues agree and certainly won't be going there "spontaneously" anymore, but will ask us if we want to "treat" ourselves to it once a month.

placeDescription: Restaurant with a softly lit bar & a completely dark dining room, so diners use non-visual senses.
text:
The Unsicht-Bar (Invisible Bar) in Berlin is a dark restaurant where the entire dinner takes place in complete darkness. You can't see the room, the food, or the people at your table. This completely alters your perception of taste, smell, sound, and your own orientation.

We went there on a Thursday evening for the murder mystery dinner "Shadows of Death," along with about 20 other guests. First, you choose a menu from the upper level. The options are vegetarian, fish, or a surprise menu. Of course, you don't know exactly what will be served, as that would spoil a large part of the experience. Allergies and dietary restrictions are noted beforehand. We also booked the wine pairing, which included four different wines to accompany each course.

After a welcome drink, we went down to the cellar. There, the waitstaff met us, led us through an airlock, and then carefully escorted us to our seats in the completely dark dining room.

Surprisingly, some guests actually had to be reminded to remove their glowing smartwatches or watches. Who would have guessed that light in a dark restaurant might disturb the darkness? 😋🫣

After all the guests had found their seats, the four-course meal began. I'm deliberately not going to write what was served. Some other reviews reveal the entire menu, which I think is quite unfair to everyone who wants to be surprised.

Suffice it to say, it was by no means bland cafeteria food. We had the surprise menu, which was well-seasoned overall and offered generously sized portions. What was particularly interesting was that I didn't immediately recognize what I was eating with every ingredient. Without appearance as a guide, you focus much more on taste, texture, and smell.

It actually made me realize how often we simply eat in everyday life without really noticing the flavors. We should really take the time to savor our food more often, even in daylight.

During the meal, subtle jazz music played in the background. The noise level of the other guests was also perfectly pleasant on our evening.


Discreet jazz music played in the background. After dinner, the murder mystery show "Shadows of Death," set in Berlin in 1929, began. Two actors slipped into different roles, creating the atmosphere of old Berlin solely through voices, sounds, and acting. Two tables were even directly involved. The whole thing was funny, entertaining, and engaging. Subtle lighting effects also ensured that you didn't have to just listen.

I do have one small criticism, though: I'd previously attended the regular Dinner in the Dark at the Unsicht-Bar and this time I had the impression of being served a very similar menu. A bit more variety would be nice, especially for returning guests.

Overall, however, it was a unique experience that's definitely worth trying. We really enjoyed the combination of dining in complete darkness followed by the murder mystery.
originalText:
Die Unsicht-Bar in Berlin ist ein Dunkelrestaurant, in dem das komplette Dinner in absoluter Dunkelheit stattfindet. Man sieht weder den Raum noch das Essen oder die Menschen am eigenen Tisch. Dadurch nimmt man Geschmack, Gerüche, Geräusche und die eigene Orientierung plötzlich ganz anders wahr.

Wir waren an einem Donnerstagabend zum Krimi-Dinner „Schatten des Todes“ dort, gemeinsam mit ungefähr 20 weiteren Gästen. Zunächst sucht man sich im oberen Bereich ein Menü aus. Zur Auswahl stehen vegetarisch, Fisch oder ein Überraschungsmenü. Was genau serviert wird, erfährt man natürlich nicht, denn sonst wäre ein großer Teil des Erlebnisses dahin. Allergien und Lebensmittel, die man nicht isst, werden vorher abgefragt. Zusätzlich hatten wir die Weinbegleitung mit vier verschiedenen Weinen zu den einzelnen Gängen gebucht.

Nach einem Begrüßungsgetränk ging es für uns in den Keller.  Dort wurden wir vom Servicepersonal abgeholt, durch eine Schleuse geführt und anschließend vorsichtig zu unseren Plätzen im vollkommen dunklen Gastraum begleitet.

Erstaunlicherweise muss man einige Gäste tatsächlich noch daran erinnern, ihre leuchtenden Smartwatches oder Uhren abzunehmen. Wer hätte auch ahnen können, dass Licht in einem Dunkelrestaurant eventuell die Dunkelheit stören könnte? 😋🫣

Nachdem alle Gäste ihre Plätze gefunden hatten, begann das Vier-Gänge-Menü. Ich werde bewusst nicht schreiben, was es zu essen gab. In einigen anderen Rezensionen wird das komplette Menü verraten, was ich ziemlich unfair gegenüber allen finde, die sich noch überraschen lassen möchten.

Nur so viel: Es war keinesfalls fades Kantinenessen. Wir hatten das Überraschungsmenü, das insgesamt gut gewürzt war und ausreichend große Portionen bot. Besonders interessant war, dass ich nicht bei jeder Zutat sofort erkannt habe, was ich gerade esse. Ohne das Aussehen als Orientierung konzentriert man sich viel stärker auf Geschmack, Konsistenz und Geruch.

Dabei wurde mir tatsächlich bewusst, wie oft man im Alltag einfach isst, ohne den Geschmack wirklich wahrzunehmen. Eigentlich sollte man sich auch im Hellen viel häufiger die Zeit nehmen, genauer hinzuschmecken.

Während des Essens lief dezente Jazzmusik im Hintergrund. Auch die Lautstärke der Gäste war an unserem Abend vollkommen angenehm.

Nach dem Dinner begann das Krimiprogramm „Schatten des Todes“, das im Berlin des Jahres 1929 spielt. Zwei Schauspieler schlüpften in verschiedene Rollen und ließen das alte Berliner Milieu allein durch Stimmen, Geräusche und Schauspiel entstehen. Zwei Tische wurden sogar direkt einbezogen. Das Ganze war lustig, unterhaltsam und kurzweilig. Kleine Lichteffekte sorgten außerdem dafür, dass man nicht ausschließlich zuhören musste.

Einen kleinen Kritikpunkt habe ich dennoch: Ich war bereits früher einmal zum normalen Dinner in the Dark in der Unsicht-Bar und hatte dieses Mal den Eindruck, ein sehr ähnliches Menü zu bekommen. Gerade für wiederkehrende Gäste wäre etwas mehr Abwechslung schön.

Insgesamt aber ein besonderes Erlebnis, das man definitiv einmal ausprobieren kann. Die Kombination aus Essen in völliger Dunkelheit und anschließendem Krimi hat uns gut gefallen.

placeAddress: Sticks'n'Sushi - Restaurant Torstraße, Torstraße 171, 10115 Berlin, Germany
text:
We visited the branch on Torstraße on June 20th and sat outside in the lovely weather. Sticks’n’Sushi is usually one of our favorite restaurants. The food was, as always, delicious, and overall, the visit started off pleasantly.

Unfortunately, we had an unpleasant experience at the end. Our original bill was around €150. Thanks to the loyalty program, we were able to redeem points, and some items were complimentary, bringing the final amount down to approximately €103–105.

When we tried to pay by card, the waiter automatically added a 10% tip without asking. It's not that I don't want to tip in general, but rather that I want to decide for myself whether and how much I tip. I found it quite rude and unprofessional that this was added without my consent.

It's a shame, because we really like the food and the restaurant itself. I hope this doesn't happen again in the future.
originalText:
Wir waren am 20.06. in der Filiale in der Torstraße und haben bei schönem Wetter draußen gesessen. Eigentlich ist Sticks’n’Sushi einer unserer Lieblingsläden. Das Essen war wie immer sehr lecker und insgesamt war der Besuch zunächst angenehm.

Leider hatten wir am Ende eine unschöne Erfahrung. Unsere ursprüngliche Rechnung lag bei ca. 150 €. Durch das Treueprogramm konnten wir Punkte einlösen und einige Dinge gingen aufs Haus, sodass der Endbetrag bei etwa 103–105 € lag.

Als wir mit Karte bezahlen wollten, hat der Kellner ohne Rückfrage selbstständig 10 % Trinkgeld hinzugefügt. Es geht mir dabei nicht darum, grundsätzlich kein Trinkgeld geben zu wollen, sondern darum, dass ich selbst entscheiden möchte, ob und wie viel ich gebe. Dass dies ohne meine Zustimmung eingetragen wurde, fand ich ziemlich dreist und unprofessionell.

Schade, denn das Essen und das Restaurant selbst gefallen uns sehr. Ich hoffe, dass so etwas künftig nicht mehr vorkommt.
ownerResponseText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for your review and the description of the situation. We are delighted to hear that you enjoy our restaurant and that we have had the pleasure of welcoming you as a regular customer.

We would like to apologize for the misunderstanding regarding tipping. We agree with your description that such behavior is very unprofessional. Every guest should feel comfortable with tipping and make their own decision.

We recently started using new terminals for credit card payments, which we are still continuously fine-tuning. Accordingly, all employees are instructed to inform our guests about tipping practices, something we unfortunately missed in this instance.

We have already taken steps to prevent such situations from recurring and would like to offer our sincerest apologies once again. We would like to learn more about this situation and would appreciate it if you would contact us directly.

Sincerely,
Oliver
Assistant General Manager
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Sehr geerhter Gast,

vielen Dank für Ihre Bewertung und die Beschreibung der Situation. Wir freuen uns zu hören, dass es Ihnen unser Restaurant sehr gefällt und wir Sie schon regelmäßig begrüßen durften. 

Wir möchten uns für das Missverständnis der Trinkgeldsituation entschuldigen. Wir stimmen Ihrer Beschreibung zu, dass ein solches Verhalten sehr unprofessionell ist. Jeder Gast sollte sich beim Thema Trinkgeld wohl fühlen und seine eigene Entscheidung dazu treffen.

Seid kurzem arbeiten wir mit neuen Terminals für Kreditkartenzahlungen , welche wir noch fortlaufend justieren. Dementsprechend sind alle Mitarbeiter angehalten, unsere Gäste bei der Trinkgeldsituation aufzuklären, was uns in dieser Situation entgangen ist. 

Wir haben bereits Maßnahmen getroffen, dass eine solche Situation nicht mehr auftritt und möchten uns nochmals in aller Form entschuldigen. Gerne würden wir mehr zu dieser Situation herausfinden und würden uns über eine direkte Kontaktaufnahme freuen. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Oliver
Assistant General Manager

placeDescription: Cozy, laid-back place turning out contemporary Spanish-inspired small plates & empanadas.
text:
Once you've had chimichurri, you'll always want chimichurri: That was our first dish at Mantanga, and it completely won us over. My wife and I were here for the first time today. We are very discerning restaurant-goers, and the tapas—compared to other Spanish tapas restaurants—really impressed us: We had croquettes with Serrano ham, beef with chimichurri, empanadas (pulled pork and mushrooms), prawns, and cheesecake—muy bien—muy delicacado—muy rico. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. The restroom is also a highlight—not usually worth mentioning in Berlin—but this one deserves a mention: pure rainforest feeling. Plants cascade from the ceiling, accompanied by the sounds of thunder and rain. The restroom here becomes an oasis.

We're looking forward to our next visit.
originalText:
Einmal Chimichurri immer Chimichurri: Das war unser erstes Gericht im Mantanga und es hat uns vollständig überzeugt. Meine Frau und ich waren heute zum ersten Mal hier. Wir sind sehr anspruchsvolle Restaurant-Gänger und die Tapas haben uns - im Vergleich zu anderen spanischen Tapas-Restaurants - sehr überzeugt: Wir hatten Kroketten mit Serrano-Schinken, Rindfleisch mit Chimichurri, Empanadas (Pulled-pork und Pilze), Gambas, Käsekuchen - muy bien - muy delicacado - muy rico. Das Personal ist super freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ein Highlight ist auch die Toilette - in Berlin eigentlich nicht erwähnenswert - aber diese Toilette muss man beschreiben: Regenwald-Feeling pur. Pflanzen ranken von der Decke dazu Gewitter- und Regen-Sound. Das Stille Örtchen wird hier zur Oase.

Wir freuen uns auf das nächste mal.

text:
Delicious spot to try authentic Turkish manti inside Markthalle Neun in Kreuzberg. I had been looking forward to visiting this place for a while and it definitely lived up to expectations.

There were two options for the manti, one filled with beef and one with spinach and cheese. I went for the beef version and it was excellent. According to my Turkish friend it looked and tasted like the real deal, which says a lot. The dumplings were soft and flavorful, and the yoghurt combined with the paprika butter sauce was seriously addictive.

If you are exploring Markthalle Neun, this is definitely one of the food stalls you should not miss.

text:

The team is attentive, friendly, and takes their time without seeming forced. You feel welcome, whether you're a first-timer or a regular.

Even the sauce is simply perfect. Everything is harmonious; nothing seems accidental.

For me, Manti Berlin is a true favorite. Honest food, a great atmosphere, and a place you'll immediately recommend to your friends.

text:
For me, the best Adana kebab.

I've eaten Adana kebab in many places, both in Turkey and in various European countries. However, this restaurant serves one of the best Adana kebabs I've ever had.

The lamb has an intense, natural flavor, and the fat balance is perfect. This keeps the kebab exceptionally juicy and gives it a wonderful aroma.

The pistachio kofte is also highly recommended. It's incredibly juicy, flavorful, and a great alternative to the classic Adana kebab.

As a side dish, you should definitely order the Nar Ekşili salad and the ezme. Both are fresh, perfectly seasoned, and go perfectly with the grilled dishes.

If you want to enjoy authentic Turkish barbecue at its finest, this is the place to go. I always enjoy coming back here.
originalText:
Für mich das beste Adana Kebab

Ich habe bereits an vielen Orten Adana Kebab gegessen, sowohl in der Türkei als auch in verschiedenen Ländern Europas. Dieses Restaurant serviert für mich jedoch eines der besten Adana Kebabs überhaupt.

Das Lammfleisch hat einen intensiven Eigengeschmack und die Fettbalance ist perfekt abgestimmt. Dadurch bleibt das Kebab besonders saftig und entwickelt ein hervorragendes Aroma.

Ebenso empfehlenswert ist die Pistazien-Köfte. Sie ist unglaublich saftig, geschmackvoll und eine tolle Alternative zum klassischen Adana Kebab.

Als Beilage sollte man unbedingt den Nar Ekşili Salat und die Ezme bestellen. Beide sind frisch, hervorragend gewürzt und passen perfekt zu den Grillgerichten.

Wer authentische türkische Grillküche auf höchstem Niveau genießen möchte, ist hier genau richtig. Ich komme immer wieder gerne hierher.

text:
I recently dined at Asia Pavillon and am still thrilled with the experience. I've rarely visited a restaurant that places such high value on quality, freshness, and hospitality. I'd especially like to highlight the duck with vegetables, which was simply exceptional. The duck was crispy on the outside, tender and full of flavor on the inside, while the vegetables were cooked to perfection – crisp, aromatic, and wonderfully balanced. You can immediately taste the passion that goes into the cooking.

The service also deserves high praise. The team was attentive, friendly, and always helpful without being intrusive. As a guest, you truly feel welcome and well taken care of. The restaurant's atmosphere is pleasant, clean, and inviting – a place where you immediately feel at ease.

What impressed me most was the consistency: everything seemed well-planned, professional, and yet warm and welcoming. This is exactly what you imagine a perfect restaurant visit to be. I will definitely return and can recommend Asia Pavillon to anyone who appreciates excellent food and outstanding service.
originalText:
Ich war vor Kurzem im Asia Pavillon essen und bin immer noch begeistert von diesem Erlebnis. Selten habe ich ein Restaurant besucht, das so viel Wert auf Qualität, Frische und Gastfreundschaft legt. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich die Ente mit Gemüse, die einfach außergewöhnlich gut war. Die Ente war außen knusprig, innen zart und voller Geschmack, während das Gemüse perfekt gegart war – knackig, aromatisch und wunderbar abgestimmt. Man schmeckt sofort, dass hier mit Leidenschaft gekocht wird.
Auch der Service verdient ein großes Lob. Das Team war aufmerksam, freundlich und jederzeit hilfsbereit, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken. Man fühlt sich als Gast wirklich willkommen und gut aufgehoben. Die Atmosphäre im Restaurant ist angenehm, sauber und einladend – ein Ort, an dem man sich sofort wohlfühlt.
Was mich besonders beeindruckt hat, ist die Konstanz: Alles wirkte durchdacht, professionell und gleichzeitig herzlich. Genau so stellt man sich einen perfekten Restaurantbesuch vor. Ich werde definitiv wiederkommen und kann den Asia Pavillon jedem empfehlen, der hervorragendes Essen und großartigen Service schätzt.

text: The menu is mixture of french and italian food. We had two types of crepes (suzettes and bacon and eggs). Both crepes were very far away from french crepes. The coffee was average. I drank “Primitivo” red wine (the Chianti is in the menu, but they don’t have), it was very good. The service was typical Italian (hectic). They play french music (of course not live). It is a suitable place to stop for a rest, but I don’t recommand to eat anything. The room is very tiny, max. 15-20 people. They have a very small terrace.
ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your feedback!

We do not serve East Anglian galettes as a matter of principle! And as you yourself have noticed, we apologize that our coffee tastes just like anywhere else! And thank you for pointing out that my staff was very honest with you in informing you that your wine order could not be fulfilled at this time and that you were offered an alternative wine! Incidentally, our terrace has 16 tables, which are of course unavailable in this weather!
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Vielen Dank für Ihre Meinung!

Wir servieren grundsätzlich keine Ost Britischen Gallette! Und wie Sie selbst erkannt haben, bitten wir um Entschuldigung, das unser Kaffe genauso schmeckt wie überall! Und Danke, das Sie mich darauf hingewiesen haben, das mein Personal Ihnen gegenüber sehr ehrlich gewesen ist, Ihnen Mitzuteilen, das Ihre Weinbestellubg derzeit nicht erfüllt werden und Ihnen ein anderer Wein empfohlen worden ist! Und unsere Terrasse verfügt im übrigen über 16 Tische, welche bei dem Wetter natürlich nicht zur Verfügung stehen!

text: A pretty good chicken restaurant, but a bit pricey. The ambiance is great, although some of the table lamps aren't working because the batteries are dead. However, there's overhead lighting that provides sufficient illumination. The background music was a bit too quiet for my taste. The service was good, and my extra requests, like an additional straw, were met. I also enjoyed the food. With the wings, you can choose the spice level, and the "spicy" setting here is actually spicy (which isn't always the case). We let the waiter roll dice to determine his own tip, which he seemed to like (I recommend this method). All in all, very satisfied, except for the price.

text: Well, the service and preparation here are really not great: often slow, inattentive, very unprofessional or untrained staff who are too preoccupied with themselves (smoking, arguing). The pizza is unfortunately only mediocre. I could only taste two ingredients in my Margherita: pizza dough (good!) and a thick layer of some strange non-mozzarella cheese (bad!) - nothing else, no tomatoes, no mozzarella, no basil (isn't that what makes a Margherita?). So it had absolutely no good taste and wasn't enjoyable at all (I was just hungry and it was warm, so I ate it, so what?). Very disappointing overall. ++ It's a shame, really, because the ambiance is cozy and would lead you to expect better, despite the very loud music. ++ The rather high prices are not justified here, because you can get mediocre pizza much cheaper, faster, and with better service elsewhere. First and foremost, the term "pizzeria" is absolutely, utterly inappropriate here. "Upscale student pub with premium prices" would be more fitting, in my opinion. ++ However, if all the other restaurants nearby are closed, you could still eat here. ++ I wish the owners much success and a speedy recovery (ask someone with experience in the restaurant business). All the best! 😁
originalText: Naja, ist echt nicht der Kracher hier bzgl. Service und Zubereitung: Oft langsames, unaufmerksames, sehr unprofessionelles bzw. ungelerntes Personal, das sich zu viel mit sich selbst beschäftigt (rauchen, diskutieren). Die Pizza schmeckt leider auch nur mittelmäßig. Aus meiner Margherita habe ich genau zwei Zutaten herausgeschmecken können: Pizzateig (gut!) sowie eine dicke Schicht sonderbaren Nicht-Mozzarella-Käse (schlecht!) - sonst nichts, weder Tomaten noch Mozzarella noch Basilikum (macht dies nicht eine Margherita aus?). Es hatte also absolut keinen guten Geschmack und es war auch kein Genuss (ich hatte einfach nur Hunger und es war warm, also hab ich es gegessen, so what) sehr enttäuschend insgesamt. ++ Schade eigentlich, denn das Ambiente wiederum ist gemütlich und würde was Besseres erwarten lassen, trotz der sehr lauten Beschallung. ++  Die recht hohen Preise sind insgesamt hier nicht gerechtfertigt, denn Mittelmaß bekommt man woanders auch deutlich günstiger, schneller, service-orientierter. Allem voran ist der Begriff Pizzeria ist hier auf jeden Fall von A bis Z sowas von dermaßen absolut Fehl am Platz. "Gehobene Studentenkneipe mit exklusiven Preisen" wäre aus meiner Sicht passend. ++ Dennoch: wenn in der Nähe alle anderen Gastros geschlossen sein sollten, kann man auch hier schon einmal essen gehen. ++ Ich wünsche den Inhabern viel Erfolg und gute Besserung (fragt mal jemanden mit Erfahrung, wie Gastro geht) Alles Gute 😁

text: Do not patronize this business. They open at 8 AM five days a week. I arrived at 8 AM. They had nothing to sell. They said we will have the cinnamon rolls in 40 minutes. Fine, odd but OK. I arrived back again in 45 minutes, and they said we have none left. It'll be two more hours because all of the cinnamon rolls went out to delivery. I said why didn't you tell me that 45 minutes ago? All I got in response was a shrug. Don't bother doing business with this company. Throughout the entire world, bakers arrive at 4 o'clock in the morning to make the first batch to sell when they open. What is the point of opening at 8 AM if you have nothing to sell? They very clearly have become far too popular online so they no longer care about your business. For context, I travel for a living. I'm very familiar with how businesses differ between countries. This one simply doesn't care.

placeAddress: Die Backpfeife, Holzmarktstraße 25, 10243 Berlin-Bezirk Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Germany
text:
As a local who stops in regularly, Die Backpfeife has become one of those places I really love. It's a small, unpretentious bakery that does exactly what it sets out to do – and does it well.

Whether you're picking up a loaf to accompany dinner or grabbing something fresh for the table, the quality consistently delivers. Flavour-wise, it punches well above its price point, which is refreshingly low for a bakery of this calibre.

What makes the experience even better is the staff. Warm and welcoming, they move effortlessly between German, English, French, and quite possibly other languages too – a real asset in a neighbourhood that draws people from all over. You never feel rushed or out of place, whether you're a regular or a first-time visitor.

And there's more to this place than great bread: Die Backpfeife was awarded the Inklusionspreis Berlin 2025 for inclusive employment practices among small businesses — recognition from the city itself that this is an employer doing things the right way. It's the kind of detail that makes you feel even better about spending your money here.

No fuss, no pretension — just good bread, good prices, friendly multilingual service, and a genuine commitment to their community. Highly recommended.

text:
Excellent stay! The hotel is very well located for visiting Berlin, the staff is very friendly, and the rooms are pleasant and comfortable (clean and exactly as pictured)!

We appreciated that they didn't change the sheets and towels every day, which is an environmentally conscious choice, as it's unnecessary to change them daily.

The only potential drawbacks are the overlooking of the rooms from the building opposite, depending on the room's position (but this is understandable in the city, and a curtain can easily mitigate the issue), and the noise from the hallways, which can sometimes be heard in the rooms when there's a lot of noise on the street.

Overall, the hotel is really great; more than just a place to sleep, it's a true living space where you can spend time in the ground-floor lounge, or at a table with your laptop and a coffee/snack (Zeit für Brot is a 2-minute walk away) in a pleasant and lively atmosphere.

The shared kitchen is a real plus: refrigerator, stovetop, freezer, microwave, sink, dishes... and dry goods depending on when you arrive. It's ideal for enjoying the city while staying in a hotel, without having to eat out all the time. There's also a small terrace that must be very pleasant in the summer.

There's also a co-working space on the 6th or 7th floor, a real bonus for getting some work done.

We didn't go up to the rooftop, but the view must be superb and the terrace must be lovely in the summer.

The price is quite reasonable considering the services offered.

Ideal for a couple, and probably for other travelers as well.

We had an excellent stay and we will definitely return on our next trip to Berlin.

Thank you again for this very pleasant stay!
originalText:
Excellent séjour ! L'hôtel est très bien placé pour visiter Berlin, le personnel est très sympathique, et les chambres sont sympathiques et agréables (propres, et conformes aux photos) !

Nous avons apprécié qu'ils ne changent pas les draps et serviettes tous les jours, dans un objectif écologique, car il est inutile de changer ces linges tous les jours.

Seuls potentiels inconvénients : le vis à vis des chambres sur l'immeuble en face selon la position de la chambre (mais en ville cela est compréhensible et un rideau permet de corriger l'inconvénient), le bruit dans les couloirs qui raisonne beaucoup dans les chambres, parfois quand il y a beaucoup de bruits bruyants dans le rue cela peut s'entendre dans la chambre.

Dans l'ensemble l'hôtel est vraiment intéressant, plus qu'un lieu de sommeil c'est un véritable lieu de vie où l'on peut passer un peu de temps dans le salon du rez de chaussée, ou sur une table avec son ordinateur et un café/snack (Zeit fur Brot est à 2mn à pied) dans une ambiance agréable et vivante.

La cuisine commune est un vrai atout : frigo, plaques de cuisson, congélateur, micro ondes, évier, vaisselle... et des aliments secs selon le moment où l'on passe. Idéale pour profiter de la ville, dans un hôtel, sans aller au restaurant tout le temps. avec une petite terrasse surement très agréable en été.

Il y a aussi un espace de co working au 6e ou au 7e étage, un vrai plus pour travailler un peu.
Et nous n'avons pas été sur le rooftop mais la vue doit etre superbe et la terrasse doit etre très agréable en été.

Le tarif est tout à fait honnête compte tenu des services proposés.

Idéal pour un couple, surement aussi pour d'autres voyageurs.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et nous y retournerons sans hésiter lors de notre prochain voyage à Berlin.

Merci encore pour ce séjour très agréable !
